programme.title: Rocket Singh
programme.sub-title: Salesman Of The Year
programme.desc: Harpreet, a fresh graduate, enters sales but struggles with its demands. He seeks balance between career pressures and his inner values, finding an unconventional solution that transforms his world. Release Year: 2009 Director: Shimit Amin Awards: 55th Filmfare Awards 2010: Best Actor Critics - Ranbir Kapoor, GQ Awards India 2010: Actor of the Year - Ranbir Kapoo.

programme.title: Do Aur Do Paanch
programme.desc: Rival thieves Sunil and Vijay target the same victims, landing in trouble. Matters worsen when both try to kidnap the same child for a huge ransom, triggering a series of comic twists. Release Year: 1980 Director: Rakesh Kumar.

programme.title: Tiger Zinda Hai
programme.desc: RAW Agent Tiger teams up with Zoya to rescue nurses trapped by terrorists. Together, they face danger and risk everything to bring the hostages to safety in a daring mission. Release Year: 2017 Director: Ali Abbas Zafar Awards: 2018 WinnerTechnical Award- Best Action- Tom Struthersstunt coordinator, 2018 WinnerTechnical Award- Best Cinematography- Marcin Laskawiec.

programme.title: Guest Iin London
programme.desc: Aryan and his wife are saddled with the responsibility of uninvited guests, who have a dozen desi quirks and no sense of boundaries. Release Year: 2017 Director: Ashwani Dhir.

programme.title: Vip 2: Lalkar
programme.desc: Raghuvaran, a young professional, sees his life made miserable by a businesswoman named Vasundhara when he declines her job offer. He thus assembles a group to take matters into their own hands. Release Year: 2017 Director: Soundarya Rajinikanth Vishagan.

programme.title: Anaarkali Of Aarah
programme.desc: Anarkali, a dancer who performs on lewd numbers, finds herself wronged by the law when no action is taken against her being molested. She, however, is determined to seek revenge.

programme.title: Lajja
programme.desc: Four women from different walks of life, all victims of male chauvinism, are brought together due to common circumstances. Release Year: 2001 Director: Rajkumar Santoshi.

programme.title: Noorie
programme.desc: Yusuf and Noorie are set to get married but after her father's sudden death, the wedding is postponed. While work takes Yusuf out of town, Noorie is left to fend for herself from many evils. Release Year: 1979 Director: Manmohan Krishna.

programme.title: The Burning Train
programme.desc: Vinod, a railway engineer, launches the Super Express, a dream project that is India's fastest passenger train. However, it goes out of control on its maiden journey due to a bomb planted by a rival. Release Year: 1980 Director: Ravi Chopra.

programme.title: Kuch Tum Kaho Kuch Hum Kahein
programme.desc: Abhay falls in love with Mangala, but in order to get his parents' approval, he has an uphill task - reconciliation between their two families. Release Year: 2002 Director: Karan Johar.

programme.title: Deewana
programme.desc: Newlywed Kajal's husband Ravi is killed by his enemies. She moves to the city and marries again, but her happiness is jinxed when Ravi returns. Release Year: 1992 Director: Raj Kanwar Awards: 1993 Winner Filmfare Award- Best Music Direction- Nadeem Saifi, Shravan Rathod, 1993 Winner Filmfare Award- Best Lyricist- Sameer, 1993 Winner Filmfare Award- Best Playback Singer- Kumar Sanu, 1993 Winner Filmfare Award- Best Debut Actor- Shah Rukh Khan.

programme.title: Made In China
programme.desc: Story of Failed Gujarati Businessman, who jumps into unknown world of China to get once in a life time business idea, which will change his life. Release Year: 2019 Director: Mikhil Musale.

programme.title: Bang Bang
programme.desc: Harleen leads a boring life with her grandmother and works as a bank receptionist. However, her life takes a sudden turn after she falls in love with Rajveer, a thief. Release Year: 2014 Director: Siddharth Anand Awards: Surfers' Choice Award - Best Music Video--Bang Bang.

programme.title: Hasee Toh Phasee
programme.desc: A quirky romantic comedy filled with misunderstandings, love, and comedic chaos explores the unpredictability of relationships. programme.desc: గాన్ ఫ్రీక్స్, అదృశ్యమైన తన తండ్రిని వెతకాలనే ఆశతో, అరుదైన రాక్షసులు, నిధిని వేటాడే హంటర్‌గా మారడానికి సిద్దమవుతాడు.

programme.title: వన్ పీస్
programme.sub-title: Monkey D Luffy, a young man made of rubber, and his team of pirates embark on an exciting adventure to find a fabled treasure
programme.desc: యువకుడు మంకీ డి లఫ్ఫీ, అతని సముద్రపు దొంగల బృందం ఒక కల్పిత నిధిని కనుగొనడానికి ఉత్తేజకరమైన సాహసయాత్రను ప్రారంభిస్తారు.

credits.actor: Mayumi Tanaka (Monkey D Luffy),Kazuya Nakai (Roronoa Zoro),Akemi Okamura (Nami),Kappei Yamaguchi (Usopp),Hiroaki Hirata (Sanji),Mahito Ôba

programme.title: కిటెరెట్సు
programme.sub-title: Kiteretsu, an elementary school student who uses his inventions to help people, and Korosuke, his robot, partake in various adventures along with his friends
programme.desc: ప్రాథమిక పాఠశాల విద్యార్థి కిటెరెట్సు, అతని రోబోట్ కొరోసుకే తన స్నేహితులతో కలిసి వివిధ సాహసాలలో పాల్గొంటారు.

credits.actor: Toshiko Fujita (Kiteretsu),Kazuko Sugiyama (Korosuke),Chieko Honda (Miyo),Yuji Mitsuya (Tongari),Mami Koyama (Korosuke),Mayumi Sho (Miyo)

programme.title: వీ బేర్ బేర్స్
programme.sub-title: Three brother bears, Grizzly, Panda, and Ice, awkwardly navigate life in the San Francisco Bay Area as they try to fit into modern human society
programme.desc: గ్రిజ్లీ, పాండా, ఐస్ లు ఆధునిక మానవ జీవితాన్ని గడిపే క్రమంలో శాన్ ఫ్రాన్సిస్కో బే ఏరియాలో ఇబ్బందులు ఎదుర్కొంటారు.

credits.actor: Bobby Moynihan (Panda),Eric Edelstein (Grizzly),Demetri Martin (Ice Bear),Charlyne Yi (Chloe),Patton Oswalt (Nom Nom),Jason Lee (Charlie)

programme.title: पूज्या दीदी मां ऋतंभराजी
programme.sub-title: A religious leader delivers an enlightening discourse on the holy scriptures and encourages devotees to live a spiritual life
programme.desc: एक धार्मिक पथ-प्रदर्शक पवित्र शास्त्रों पर ज्ञानवर्धक प्रवचन देते हैं और भक्तों को आध्यात्मिक जीवन जीने के लिए प्रोत्साहित करते हैं।.

programme.title: संत राजिंदर सिंहजी

programme.title: पूज्य सतपालजी महाराज

programme.title: Life Of A Predator

programme.title: Surviving Australia
programme.sub-title: Survivors recount incidents of being lost in the Australian wilderness, getting stuck underground, being caught in landslides, and having close encounters with some of the country's deadliest inhabitants

programme.title: Deadliest Snakes of South Africa

programme.desc: Kurt Greenwood is on a quest to seek out South Africa's twelve most deadly snakes, as well as to educate and inspire people to see the value of these often misunderstood creatures.

programme.title: Italy: The Last Wilderness Year 1
programme.sub-title: Mediterranean beech woods are considered among the most beautiful and important on the continent
programme.desc: The story of a remarkable ecosystem in the heart of Europe. Beginning in Vienna, the Danube riverbank forests extend to the gates of Bratislava, forming a unique wildlife habitat.

programme.title: Brotherhood of Lions
programme.sub-title: The young males of the lion pride must form a coalition to work together against their rivals, but they first need to leave their mothers at two years old and fend for themselves
programme.desc: In a journey that follows lions for the first five years of their lives, uncover fascinating insights into the lives of these majestic animals and discover the threats against them, such as poaching and habitat loss.

programme.title: Aussie Snake Wranglers
programme.sub-title: Chris and Stu come face-to-face with a giant red-bellied black snake that's taking shelter in a car's engine. In South Australia, Mick and Adele are helping local snake catcher, Dan, with one of his busiest snake catching seasons on record
programme.desc: Australia's busiest snake-catching team face off against some of the world's deadliest animals, tackling everything from red bellies to eastern browns and whip snakes.

programme.sub-title: An aggravated eastern brown snake drive Mick and Adele nuts before the team are called to the biggest tree snake they've ever seen. For Stuart and Olivia, it's demolition time

programme.sub-title: An orphan boy, Nela Ticket, is raised by Ananda Bhupathi at his orphanage in Bangalore. Years later, when Ananda is killed by a corrupt politician, Nela sets out to take revenge

programme.desc: Happy and Pinaki live with their ghost family in Vibhooti Mansion. They embark on spooky adventures, uncover scary secrets, and discover courage, friendship, and bravery together.

programme.sub-title: Nobita and his friends along with Doraemon go on a mystery trip through the cosmos on the Galaxy Super-express train. But trouble awaits them as soon as they reach the destination
programme.desc: நோபிட்டாவும் அவனது நண்பர்களும் டோரேமானுடன் சேர்ந்து, 'கேலக்ஸி சூப்பர்-எக்ஸ்பிரஸ்' ரயிலில் விண்வெளியினூடே ஒரு மர்மப் பயணத்தை மேற்கொள்கிறார்கள். ஆனால், அவர்கள் சென்றடையும் இடத்தில் அவர்களுக்குச் சிக்கல்கள் காத்திருக்கின்றன.

programme.title: क्राइम पैट्रोल
programme.sub-title: The host presents dramatised re-enactments of real-life crime cases that revolve around harassment, kidnapping and murder
programme.desc: प्रस्तुतकर्ता, उत्पीड़न, अपहरण और हत्या पर आधारित वास्तविक जीवन के आपराधिक मामलों का नाटकीय रूपांतरण प्रस्तुत करते हैं।.

programme.title: बेस्ट ऑफ़ क्राइम पेट्रोल
programme.sub-title: Some of the best cases of 'Crime Patrol', which investigates how innocent people turn into criminals due to the influence of evil in society
programme.desc: कार्यक्रम, 'क्राइम पेट्रोल' में हत्या, अपहरण, धोखाधड़ी और चोरी जैसे कई अपराधों से जुड़ी सच्ची कहानियों को नाट्य रूपांतरण के माध्यम से पेश किया जाता है।.

programme.title: बेस्ट ऑफ़ क्राइम पेट्रोल

programme.title: क्राइम पेट्रोल: 48 घंटे
programme.sub-title: In Maharashtra, a man named Avinash Tripathi goes missing, and two different women claiming to be his wife file a complaint with the police. Will the police be able to find Avinash and learn his truth?
programme.desc: प्रस्तुतकर्ता अपराध के मामलों का नाटकीय रूप से मंचन करते हैं तथा पुलिस विभाग द्वारा 48 घंटों के भीतर मामलों को सुलझाने के लिए किए गए सतर्क प्रयासों को दर्शाते हैं।.

programme.title: बेस्ट ऑफ़ क्राइम पेट्रोल
programme.sub-title: A compilation of the best cases investigated in 'Crime Patrol' showcases people from different walks of life falling victim to the vices of others or their own

programme.title: ரெமோ
programme.sub-title: SK, an aspiring actor, falls in love with Kavya, a doctor. However, she is engaged to another man and SK tries to sabotage their relationship by making her fall for him
programme.desc: ஏற்கனவே நிச்சயமான டாக்டர் காவ்யா மீது காதல் கொள்ளும் எஸ்.கே, நிச்சயதார்த்தத்தை உடைக்க பெண் செவிலியராக மாறுவேடமிடுகிறார்.

programme.title: Naked and Afraid
programme.sub-title: Jeremy and Melanie face the many challenges of surviving in the swamps of Louisiana, as they search for food and battle predators
programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In \"Naked and Afraid,\" complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

credits.actor: Michael Brown,Laura Zerra,Fernando Calderón,Amber Hargrove,Jim Morton

Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

programme.title: प्रेम कैदी
programme.sub-title: Harish, a poor boy, is sent to a reform school after he is falsely accused of killing his father by Kasturi Prasad, the father of his wealthy lover Neelima. Later, Neelima and Harish fight for love
programme.desc: हरीश,गरीब लड़के को सुधार स्कूल भेजा जाता है, जब उसे उसकी अमीर प्रेमीका नीलिमा के पिता, कस्तूरी प्रसाद द्वारा अपने पिता की हत्या का आरोप लगाया जाता है। बाद में, नीलिमा और हरीश प्यार के लिए लड़ते हैं।.

credits.actor: Harish,Karisma Kapoor,Shafi Inamdar,Rama Vij,Paresh Rawal,Dalip Tahil

programme.title: ख़्वाब
programme.sub-title: Pratap travels to Mumbai for better career opportunities and eventually, he gains success. Later, he falls in love with Indrani but on the day of his engagement, Pratap gets arrested
programme.desc: प्रताप बेहतर कैरियर के लिए मुंबई जाता है, जहाँ वह सफलता हासिल करता है और उसे अपने बॉस की बेटी से प्यार हो जाता है। हालत बदलते हैं जब उसे सगाई के दिन गिरफ्तार किया जाता है।.

programme.title: जुर्रत
programme.sub-title: Inspector Avinash is transferred to Mumbai and is tasked to nab smuggler Kama Seth. When Kama hoodwinks Avinash and makes him a laughingstock in the eyes of the media, he makes a dangerous decision
programme.desc: इंस्पेक्टर अविनाश, तस्कर कामा के बहकावे में आकर एक खतरनाक फैसला लेता है।.

programme.title: हथकड़ी
programme.sub-title: ACP Suraj, an honest policeman, swears revenge on culprits when his innocent brother is killed. However, he is soon accused of murder and is remanded to prison
programme.desc: एसीपी सूरज, एक ईमानदार पुलिसकर्मी है, जो अपने निर्दोष भाई की हत्या होने पर अपराधियों से बदला लेने की कसम खाता है। हालाँकि, जल्द ही उस पर हत्या का आरोप लगाया जाता है और उसे जेल भेज दिया जाता है।.

credits.actor: Govinda (ACP Suraj Chauhan / Rajnikant),Madhoo (Rani),Shilpa Shetty (Neha),Shakti Kapoor (Bhavani Shankar),Punnit Issar (Chakku Pandey),Arun Govil (Arun Chauhan),Kiran Kumar (DIG Vijaykumar)

programme.title: अग्नि साक्षी
programme.sub-title: Suraj Kapoor is a wealthy man who marries Shivangi and they both have a happy married life. Surprisingly, the couple gets approached by a man who claims that Shivangi is his wife, Madhu
programme.desc: एक अमीर आदमी, सूरज कपूर, शिवांगी से शादी करता है और दोनों अपना विवाहित जीवन व्यतीत करते हैं। एक रात, भोजन करने के दौरान, एक आदमी सूरज के पास आता है और दावा करता है कि शिवांगी उसकी पत्नी, मधु है।.

credits.actor: Jackie Shroff,Nana Patekar,Manisha Koirala,Divya Dutta,Ravi Behl,Alok Nath,Ashalata

programme.title: शोला और शबनम
programme.sub-title: Divya loves Karan and plans to get married to him. However, a notorious gangster's brother, Bali, who also has his eyes on her, goes to great lengths to destroy her relationship with Karan
programme.desc: दिव्या, करण से प्यार करती है और उससे शादी करना चाहती है लेकिन एक कुख्यात गैंगस्टर का भाई, बाली भी उसे चाहता है। वह करण के साथ उसके रिश्ते को तोड़ने की हरमुमकिन कोशिश करता है।.

credits.actor: Govinda,Divya Bharti,Gulshan Grover,Mohnish Bahl,Anupan Kher,Raja Bundela,Satyajeet,Girish Malik,Alok Nath,Harish Patel,Bindu

programme.title: तक़दीरवाला
programme.sub-title: Suraj turns his fortunes around with the help of a mysterious book that tells him the future. Before long, the Hindu god of death and the divine accountant come looking for it
programme.desc: सूरज एक रहस्यमयी किताब की मदद से अपनी किस्मत बदल लेता है, जो उसे भविष्य बताती है। कुछ ही समय बाद, मृत्यु के हिंदू देवता और दिव्य लेखाकार उस किताब की तलाश में निकल पड़ते हैं।.

credits.actor: Venkatesh Daggubati,Raveena Tandon,Kader Khan,Asrani,Laxmikant Berde,Satyendra Kapoor,Dinesh Hingoo,Shakti Kapoor

programme.title: नसीब
programme.sub-title: The lives of friends Namdev, Raghu, Damu and Jaggi take a turn for the worse when they win a lottery. Raghu and Damu murder Jaggi and frame Namdev who later returns to seek revenge
programme.desc: चार दोस्त नामदेव, रघु, दामू और जग्गी का जीवन बदल जाता है जब वे लॉटरी जीतते हैं। रघु और दामू जग्गी की हत्या करते हैं और आरोप नामदेव पर लगाते हैं। वर्षों बाद, नामदेव बदला लेने के लिए लौटता है।.

credits.actor: Amitabh Bachchan,Shatrughan Sinha,Rishi Kapoor,Hema Malini,Reena Roy,Kim Yashpal

programme.title: कमांडो
programme.sub-title: A disavowed commando escapes captivity after a year of torture at the hands of the Chinese. On his way back to India, he is roped into protecting a woman from a local goon that wants to marry her
programme.desc: एक बेवफ़ा कमांडो, एक साल तक चीनी लोगों की प्रताड़णा सहने के बाद कैद से भाग जाता है। भारत लौटते समय, उसे एक स्थानीय गुंडे से एक महिला को बचाने का काम सौंपा जाता है जो उससे शादी करना चाहता है।.

credits.actor: Vidyut Jamwal,Pooja Chopra,Jaideep Ahlawat,Sukhwinder Chahal,Darshan Jariwala,Jagat Rawat,Baljinder Kaur,Nathan Barris

programme.title: सन्तान
programme.sub-title: Sarju and Laxmi sacrifice a lot to educate their only son, Amar. Years later, Amar falls for Asha and pretends to be the son of a rich landowner, but secrets are revealed when they get married
programme.desc: गरीब, सरजू और लक्ष्मी अपने इकलौते बेटे, अमर को शिक्षित करने के लिए त्याग करते हैं। अमर, आशा के प्यार में है और अमीर जमींदार का बेटा होने का दिखावा करता है। सच उजागर होता है, जब वे शादी करते हैं।.

programme.title: லிட்டில் ஹக்கா

programme.sub-title: A Panda and a rooster become friends as they set out on exciting adventures to explore the vibrant cultures of various countries while promoting the concept of cultural diversity
programme.desc: పాండా, కోడిపుంజు స్నేహితులై సాంస్కృతిక వైవిధ్యాన్ని ప్రోత్సహిస్తూ, వివిధ దేశాల ఉత్సాహభరితమైన సంస్కృతులను అన్వేషిస్తారు.

programme.title: డేంజర్ మౌస్

programme.title: వేక్ అప్ మ్యూజిక్ ఐడీ
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive collection of refreshing songs to help audiences kick-start the day, featuring popular artists and bands
programme.desc: ప్రముఖ కళాకారులు, బ్యాండ్‌ల పాటలతో, శ్రోతలు తమ రోజును ఉత్సాహంగా ప్రారంభించడానికి సహాయపడే ఉత్తేజకరమైన పాటల సమగ్ర సమాహారం.

programme.title: లిటిల్ కృష్ణ
programme.sub-title: Little Krishna, a mischievous child, lives in the village of Vrindavan. He decides to save the villagers from an evil king, Kamsa, who sends ferocious demons upon them
programme.desc: కొంటెవాడైన చిన్ని కృష్ణుడు, ప్రజలపైకి భయంకర రాక్షసులను పంపిన దుష్ట కంసుడి నుండి బృందావన ప్రజలను కాపాడాలనుకుంటాడు.

credits.actor: Prachi Save Saathi,Meghna Erande,Neil D'Monte,Anand Tiwari,Vikrant Chaturvedi,Soniya Nair,Cara Pareira

programme.title: హ్యాపీ బర్త్ డే
programme.sub-title: Children celebrate their birthdays with a heart-touching note from their loved ones on the occasion of the special memorable day
programme.desc: పిల్లలు తమకు ఎంతో ప్రత్యేకమైన రోజు నాడు, తమ ప్రియమైన వారి నుండి హృదయాన్ని హత్తుకునే సందేశాలతో పుట్టినరోజు జరుపుకుంటారు.

programme.title: హైడీ
programme.sub-title: Heidi lives in Frankfurt and has a friend, Clara. However, after spending time at her grandfather's place in the countryside, she yearns to go back and spend time in the open mountain pasture
programme.desc: తన తాతయ్య అల్పోహితో కలిసి ఉండడానికి స్విస్ ఆల్ప్స్ వెళ్లిన హైడీ పట్ల ఆమె తాతయ్య అమితమైన ప్రేమను ఏర్పరచుకుంటాడు.

credits.actor: Kristin Fiedler (Heidi),Thomas Ohrner (Peter),Erik Jelde (Alm-Öhi),Ursula Wolff (Klara),Tilly Lauenstein (Fräulein Rottenmeier),Leon Rainer

programme.title: పంచతంత్ర నీతి కథలు
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of stories from the Panchatantra, a collection of Indian fables, that helps to instil morals and values in children
programme.desc: భారతీయ నీతి కథల సమాహారమైన, పంచతంత్ర కథల సమగ్ర సంకలనం, ఇది పిల్లలలో నైతికత, విలువలను పెంపొందించడానికి సహాయపడుతుంది.

programme.title: బూనీ బేర్స్: ది అడ్వెంచరర్స్
programme.sub-title: Briar and Bramble, two bear siblings who love their forest home, keep thwarting the nefarious logger Vick's attempts to log timber from their forest
programme.desc: ఎలుగుబంట్లు బ్రియార్, బ్రాంబుల్ తమ అడవి నుండి కలపను లాగడానికి దుర్మార్గపు విక్ చేసిన ప్రయత్నాలను విఫలం చేస్తాయి.

credits.actor: Paul \"Maxx\" Rinehart,Rick Jay Glen,Justin J. Wheeler

programme.title: టియాన్ టియాన్
programme.sub-title: Tiantian, a six-year-old innocent girl, learns about the world as she embarks on an exciting journey with her best friends
programme.desc: ఆరేళ్ళ టియాన్ టియాన్, తన స్నేహితులతో కలిసి ఉత్సహభరితమైన ప్రయాణం చేస్తూ, ఈ ప్రపంచం గురించి ఎన్నో విషయాలు తెలుసుకుంటుంది.

programme.title: గ్లోరియా'స్ హౌస్
programme.sub-title: Gloria has a messy house, but it is more fun than any other house in Chillsville. Her daily life is full of adventures as she deals with her siblings and her neighbours
programme.desc: గందరగోళంగా ఉన్న ఇంట్లో తోబుట్టువులు, పొరుగువారితో వ్యవహరించే క్రమంలో గ్లోరియా దైనందిన జీవితం అనేక సాహసాలతో నిండిపోతుంది.

programme.title: డేంజర్ మౌస్
programme.sub-title: Danger Mouse, a talented secret agent, and his faithful sidekick, Ernest Penfold, do all they can to thwart the evil plans of Baron Silas von Greenback
programme.desc: రహస్య ఏజెంట్ డేంజర్ మౌస్, ఎర్నెస్ట్ పెన్ఫోల్డ్ తో కలిసి గ్రీన్ బ్యాక్ దుష్ట ప్రణాళికలను అడ్డుకోడానికి ప్రత్నిస్తారు.

credits.actor: Alexander Armstrong (Danger Mouse),Dave Lamb,Kevin Eldon (Penfold),Stephen Fry (Colonel K)

programme.title: బూనీ కబ్స్
programme.sub-title: Little Briar and Little Bramble go down a magical tunnel at Pine Tree Kindergarten. They make many furry friends as they embark on exciting adventures and learn new things
programme.desc: లిటిల్ బ్రియార్, లిటిల్ బ్రాంబుల్‌ పైన్ ట్రీ కిండర్ గార్టెన్ ద‌గ్గ‌రి మాయాసొరంగంలోకి వెళ్లి,కొత్త విషయాలు నేర్చుకుంటారు.

programme.desc: కొంటెవాడైన చిన్ని కృష్ణుడు, ప్రజలపైకి భయంకర రాక్షసులను పంపిన దుష్ట కంసుడి నుండి బృందావన ప్రజలను కాపాడాలనుకుంటాడు.

credits.actor: Prachi Save Saathi,Meghna Erande,Neil D'Monte,Anand Tiwari,Vikrant Chaturvedi,Soniya Nair,Cara Pareira

programme.title: హ్యాపీ బర్త్ డే
programme.sub-title: Children celebrate their birthdays with a heart-touching note from their loved ones on the occasion of the special memorable day
programme.desc: పిల్లలు తమకు ఎంతో ప్రత్యేకమైన రోజు నాడు, తమ ప్రియమైన వారి నుండి హృదయాన్ని హత్తుకునే సందేశాలతో పుట్టినరోజు జరుపుకుంటారు.

programme.title: లిటిల్ కృష్ణ

programme.title: పంచతంత్ర నీతి కథలు
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of stories from the Panchatantra, a collection of Indian fables, that helps to instil morals and values in children
programme.desc: భారతీయ నీతి కథల సమాహారమైన, పంచతంత్ర కథల సమగ్ర సంకలనం, ఇది పిల్లలలో నైతికత, విలువలను పెంపొందించడానికి సహాయపడుతుంది.

programme.title: బూనీ బేర్స్: ది అడ్వెంచరర్స్
programme.sub-title: Briar and Bramble, two bear siblings who love their forest home, keep thwarting the nefarious logger Vick's attempts to log timber from their forest
programme.desc: ఎలుగుబంట్లు బ్రియార్, బ్రాంబుల్ తమ అడవి నుండి కలపను లాగడానికి దుర్మార్గపు విక్ చేసిన ప్రయత్నాలను విఫలం చేస్తాయి.

credits.actor: Paul \"Maxx\" Rinehart,Rick Jay Glen,Justin J. Wheeler

programme.title: టియాన్ టియాన్
programme.sub-title: Tiantian, a six-year-old innocent girl, learns about the world as she embarks on an exciting journey with her best friends
programme.desc: ఆరేళ్ళ టియాన్ టియాన్, తన స్నేహితులతో కలిసి ఉత్సహభరితమైన ప్రయాణం చేస్తూ, ఈ ప్రపంచం గురించి ఎన్నో విషయాలు తెలుసుకుంటుంది.

programme.title: హైడీ
programme.sub-title: Heidi lives in Frankfurt and has a friend, Clara. However, after spending time at her grandfather's place in the countryside, she yearns to go back and spend time in the open mountain pasture

programme.title: పంచతంత్ర నీతి కథలు
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of stories from the Panchatantra, a collection of Indian fables, that helps to instil morals and values in children
programme.desc: భారతీయ నీతి కథల సమాహారమైన, పంచతంత్ర కథల సమగ్ర సంకలనం, ఇది పిల్లలలో నైతికత, విలువలను పెంపొందించడానికి సహాయపడుతుంది.

programme.title: బూనీ బేర్స్: ది అడ్వెంచరర్స్
programme.sub-title: Briar and Bramble, two bear siblings who love their forest home, keep thwarting the nefarious logger Vick's attempts to log timber from their forest
programme.desc: ఎలుగుబంట్లు బ్రియార్, బ్రాంబుల్ తమ అడవి నుండి కలపను లాగడానికి దుర్మార్గపు విక్ చేసిన ప్రయత్నాలను విఫలం చేస్తాయి.

programme.title: గ్లోరియా'స్ హౌస్
programme.sub-title: Gloria has a messy house, but it is more fun than any other house in Chillsville. Her daily life is full of adventures as she deals with her siblings and her neighbours

programme.title: డేంజర్ మౌస్

programme.title: छोटा भीम
programme.sub-title: Bheem is an extremely brave, strong and intelligent young boy. He often manages to solve everyone's problems which endears him to the townspeople of Dholakpur
programme.desc: भीम एक असाधारण, शक्तिशाली और बुद्धिमान लड़का है। गाँव के सभी बच्चे उसे पसंद करते हैं, क्योंकि वह सभी की समस्याओं को हल करने में उनकी मदद करता है।.

credits.actor: Vatsal Dubey (Chhota Bheem),Julie Tejwani (Raju),Rupa Bhimani (Chutki),Sabina Malik Mausam (Kalia),Rajesh Kava (Jaggu),Prince Patel (Takiya)

programme.title: लिटिल सिंघम - काल बना विषकाल
programme.sub-title: Little Singham gets into a fix when he loses his powers. He must use his wits to fight a mighty villain who is determined to destroy the earth
programme.desc: अपनी शक्तियाँ खोने पर छोटा सिंघम मुश्किल में पड़ जाता है। और अपनी बुद्धि का प्रयोग करके एक शक्तिशाली खलनायक से लड़ता है जो पृथ्वी को नष्ट करने पर तुला है।.

programme.title: सिंघमवर्स वर्सेस कालवर्स
programme.sub-title: The Kaalverse threatens the Singhamverse in an imminent conflict. Meanwhile, a fresh guardian must rise to defend the nation and secure a fading legacy
programme.desc: कालवर्स, सिंघमवर्स के लिए एक आसन्न टकराव का खतरा पैदा करता है। इस बीच, देश की रक्षा करने और एक धूमिल होती विरासत को सुरक्षित रखने के लिए एक नए रक्षक को सामने आना होगा।.

programme.title: सिंघमवर्स वर्सेस कालवर्स
programme.sub-title: Failing to stop Reth Kaal, the Singhams follow Satrangi into the ocean multiverse. They join Pirate Singham to find the Sindu Mani and close the hell portal before Original Kaal defeats them
programme.desc: कालवर्स, सिंघमवर्स के लिए एक आसन्न टकराव का खतरा पैदा करता है। इस बीच, देश की रक्षा करने और एक धूमिल होती विरासत को सुरक्षित रखने के लिए एक नए रक्षक को सामने आना होगा।.

programme.title: ग्रिजी एण्ड द लेम्मिंग्स
programme.sub-title: Grizzy, a bear, lives in the forest ranger's house every time he leaves and considers it as his own. However, things change when a tribe of lemmings moves into the same house
programme.desc: ग्रिज़ी नामक भालू, हर बार जब वन रेंजर घर छोड़ता है तो उसके घर में रहता है और उसे अपना घर मानता है। हालाँकि, जब लेमिंग्स की एक जनजाति उसी घर में रहने आती है तो चीजें बदल जाती हैं।.

credits.director: Victor Moulin,Cédric Lachenaud,Alexandre Wahl,Corentin Lecourt,Clément Girard,Idriss Benseghir,Célestine Jacquel-Plays

programme.desc: ग्रिज़ी नामक भालू, हर बार जब वन रेंजर घर छोड़ता है तो उसके घर में रहता है और उसे अपना घर मानता है। हालाँकि, जब लेमिंग्स की एक जनजाति उसी घर में रहने आती है तो चीजें बदल जाती हैं।.

credits.director: Victor Moulin,Cédric Lachenaud,Alexandre Wahl,Corentin Lecourt,Clément Girard,Idriss Benseghir,Célestine Jacquel-Plays

programme.title: लिटिल सिंघम और पिरामिड्स का रहस्य
programme.sub-title: Upon receiving a note from Sheik Abdullah, Singham and his friends travel to Egypt to help with a newly discovered sarcophagus
programme.desc: शेख अब्दुल्ला से एक नोट मिलने करने के बाद, सिंघम और उसके दोस्त खोजे गए नए ताबूत के निर्माण में मदद करने के लिए मिस्र की यात्रा करते हैं।.

programme.title: लिटिल सिंघम: दे धना धन क्रिकेट वर्ल्ड कप
programme.sub-title: Little Singham, a ferocious young police officer, participates in the cricket World Cup finale to help the Indian team win the trophy

programme.title: छोटा भीम

programme.title: स्मैशिंग सिम्बा
programme.sub-title: Simmba, an honest and courageous police officer, teams up with his fearless colleagues in his mission to confront and defeat the evil forces of society

programme.title: छोटा भीम-भीमायन
programme.sub-title: Chhota Bheem and his friends put on a stage show of the Ramayana on the auspicious occasion of Diwali and re-enact the epic tale behind the festival of lights
programme.desc: छोटा भीम और उसके दोस्त दिवाली के शुभ अवसर पर रामायण का नाट्यमंचन प्रस्तुत करते हैं और रोशनी के इस त्यौहार के पीछे की महाकाव्य कथा को पुनः प्रस्तुत करते हैं।.

programme.title: छोटा भीम अँड हातिम: द लेजेंड ऑफ द फर्स्ट जिन
programme.desc: Chhota Bheem And Hatim:The Legend Of The First Jinn.

programme.title: छोटा भीम: लेजेंड ऑफ द जाइअन्ट्स!
programme.sub-title: As Garajasur threatens the village's protective ritual against demons, Bheem and mystical guardians unite to safeguard everyone

programme.sub-title: Little Singham, a young but ferocious policeman and his friends set out on an adventure with their friends in order to fight the evil forces

programme.title: आरआरआर5 एलएस एण्ड सीबी सूर्यवंशी योद्धा
programme.sub-title: Chhota Bheem and Little Singham join forces to defeat the rising evil with their tactics and bring back happiness to their lands

programme.title: छोटा भीम और लिटिल सिंघम - आइस एज का आतंक
programme.sub-title: Chhota Bheem and Little Singham join forces as they embark on a new mission on frozen islands to fight against the mighty icy monsters

programme.title: एलएस एण्ड छोटा भीम राइज़ ऑफ बेताल

programme.title: ग्रिजी एण्ड द लेम्मिंग्स
programme.sub-title: Grizzy, a bear, lives in the forest ranger's house every time he leaves and considers it as his own. However, things change when a tribe of lemmings moves into the same house
programme.desc: ग्रिज़ी नामक भालू, हर बार जब वन रेंजर घर छोड़ता है तो उसके घर में रहता है और उसे अपना घर मानता है। हालाँकि, जब लेमिंग्स की एक जनजाति उसी घर में रहने आती है तो चीजें बदल जाती हैं।.

credits.director: Victor Moulin,Cédric Lachenaud,Alexandre Wahl,Corentin Lecourt,Clément Girard,Idriss Benseghir,Célestine Jacquel-Plays

programme.desc: जीवित बचे लोग ऑस्ट्रेलिया के सुदूर इलाकों से अपने भयावह पलायन की कहानियाँ सुनाते हैं, जबकि विशेषज्ञ आम मिथकों को तोड़ते हुए जीवित रहने के लिए आवश्यक व्यावहारिक रणनीतियाँ बताते हैं।.

programme.title: डेड्लीएस्ट साउथ अफ्रीका
programme.sub-title: Kurt Greenwood is on a quest to seek out South Africa's most deadly snakes in order to educate and inspire people to see the value of these misunderstood creatures
programme.desc: कर्ड्ट ग्रीनवुड दक्षिण अफ्रीका के बारह सबसे घातक साँपों की खोज में लगे हैं, साथ ही वे लोगों को इन अक्सर गलत समझे जाने वाले जीवों के मूल्य को समझने के लिए शिक्षित और प्रेरित भी कर रहे हैं।.

programme.title: इटली: द लास्ट वाइल्डरनेस इयर 1
programme.sub-title: Explore the life of a family of brown bears in a year, the special characteristics of the rutting season of Roe Deer in the Mountains of Central Italy, and the migration of salamanders in autumn
programme.desc: फिल्म निर्माता यूरोप के दिल, डेन्यूब नदी के किनारे के जंगलों के पारिस्थितिकी तंत्र में पनप रहे अद्वितीय वन्यजीव आवास के बारे में गहराई से जानते हैं।.

programme.title: ब्रदरहुड ऑफ लायन्स

programme.title: औसी स्नेक रैंगलर्स

programme.desc: विशेषज्ञ, ऑस्ट्रेलियाई घरों में छिपे दुनिया के सबसे घातक सांपों में से कुछ को पकड़ने की कोशिश में जीवन को दाँव पर लगा कर खतरनाक स्थितियों का सामना करते हैं।.

programme.title: द सवाना: वाइल्ड हैप्पिनेस

programme.sub-title: Jeremy was once pulled into a river by a goonch catfish during his very first investigation. Years later, he is worried that the monster has reappeared
programme.desc: प्रस्तुतकर्ता जो एक जीवविज्ञानी और मछुआरा हैं, वे कई मिथकों को खत्म करने और उनसे जुड़ी खौफ़नाक कहानियों को जानने के लिए मीठे पानी के रहस्यों और स्थानीय लोककथाओं की पड़ताल करते हैं।.

programme.title: लायन्स व्हर्सेस हायनाज
programme.sub-title: It has been a year since the lionesses of the Boulder Pride gave birth to their cubs. Now, they must hunt without the support of the rest of the family, with hyenas hot on their heels
programme.desc: फ़िल्मकार शेरों और लकड़बग्घों के व्यवहार का परीक्षण करते हैं तथा उनकी कथित प्रतिद्वंद्विता के बारे में पूर्वधारणाओं को चुनौती देते हैं।.

programme.title: स्नो लेपर्ड्स विथ डॅन ओ'नील
programme.desc: Dan O'Neill, a biologist and naturalist, travels to Central Asia in an attempt to build a research centre and study the snow leopard.

programme.sub-title: From the Arctic tundra to the Great Plains, the kingdom of the wolf extends across the entire Northern Hemisphere; wolves are icons of the wilderness and spectacular creatures that live and die by the sword

programme.desc: जीवित बचे लोग ऑस्ट्रेलिया के सुदूर इलाकों से अपने भयावह पलायन की कहानियाँ सुनाते हैं, जबकि विशेषज्ञ आम मिथकों को तोड़ते हुए जीवित रहने के लिए आवश्यक व्यावहारिक रणनीतियाँ बताते हैं।.

programme.title: सर्च ऑफ द किंग कोबरा
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker explores the behavioural characteristics and mating habits of King Cobras through a snake expert, who catches the serpents from people's houses and releases them in uninhabited areas
programme.desc: फिल्म निर्माता, विशेषज्ञ से किंग कोबरा के व्यवहार संबंधी विशेषताओं और संभोग की आदतों के बारे में जानते हैं, जो घरों से साँपों को पकड़ उन्हें निर्जन क्षेत्रों में छोड़ देता है।.

programme.title: ब्रदरहुड ऑफ लायन्स
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker captures the activities of female and male lions with their new cubs who form a group of thirteen to hunt their prey
programme.desc: फ़िल्मकार केन्या के मसाई मारा रिजर्व में रहने वाले पाँच युवा शेरों के जीवन पर प्रकाश डालते हैं, साथ ही वे उनके द्वारा सामना किए जा रहे शिकार और आवास का नुकसान जैसे कई खतरों पर भी प्रकाश डालते हैं।.

Now comes a reality show on TLC, which says Lee is a `celebrity who has pioneered the fastest growing medical fascination in decades.'.

programme.title: Naked and Afraid
programme.sub-title: Jeremy and Melanie face the many challenges of surviving in the swamps of Louisiana, as they search for food and battle predators
programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In \"Naked and Afraid,\" complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

credits.actor: Michael Brown,Laura Zerra,Fernando Calderón,Amber Hargrove,Jim Morton

programme.sub-title: Scientists, structural engineers and other experts speculate about what the Earth would look like if human beings suddenly ceased to exist
programme.desc: శాస్త్రవేత్తలు, ఇంజినీర్లు, ఇతర నిపుణులు మానవులు అకస్మాత్తుగా ఉనికిలో లేకుండాపోతే భూమి ఎలా ఉంటుందో వివరిస్తారు.

programme.title: స్మాల్ బడ్జెట్ బిగ్ మేక్ఓవర్
programme.sub-title: The hosts, who are interior designers, embark on a mission, unleashing their creativity to help people renovate their homes with a small budget
programme.desc: ఇంటీరియర్ డిజైనర్లు అయిన వ్యాఖ్యాతలు, ప్రజలు తమ ఇళ్లను పునరుద్ధరించడంలో సహాయపడటానికి వారి సృజనాత్మకతను వెలికితీస్తారు.

programme.title: కౌంటింగ్ కార్స్
programme.sub-title: Danny Koker and his crew are fans of the coolest American cars and are involved in the restoration and modification of classic cars and bikes
programme.desc: అమెరికన్ కార్ల అభిమానులైన డానీ కోకర్, అతని సిబ్బంది క్లాసిక్ కార్లు, బైక్‌లను రిపేర్ చేసి, అందంగా తీర్చిదిద్దుతుంటారు.

programme.title: అమెరికన్ రిస్టోరేషన్
programme.sub-title: A team of expert craftsmen brings old, worn-out antiques back to life, restoring vintage treasures while sharing the fascinating stories behind each unique item
programme.desc: నిపుణుల బృందం ఉద్యోగ సమయంలో అమెరికన్ పాతకాలపు వస్తువులను వాటి అసలు స్థితికి పునరుద్ధరించడానికి ప్రయత్నిస్తుంది.

credits.actor: Bodie Stroud,Dale Walksler,Andy Bowman Jr.,Steve Hale,Bob Halliday,Rick Dale,Tyler Dale

programme.title: ఫోర్జ్డ్ ఇన్ ఫైర్
programme.sub-title: Top bladesmiths from different walks of life compete to create the best weapons and prove their effectiveness in a series of daunting challenges
programme.desc: ప్రముఖ బ్లేడ్ స్మిత్‌లు ఉత్తమ ఆయుధాలను రూపొందించడానికి, కఠినమైన సవాళ్లలో వాటి సమర్థతను నిరూపించుకోవడానికి పోటీపడతారు.

credits.actor: Grady Powell,J. Neilson,Doug Marcaida,David Baker,Ben Abbott,Wil Willis,Jason Knight

programme.title: ది ఐన్‌స్టీన్ ఛాలెంజ్
programme.sub-title: Amado DeHoyas and Ed Miller are two aeronautical experts from NASA who explore various concepts from flight of a plane to stealth bombers
programme.desc: వివిధ రంగాలలోని ఇద్దరు నిపుణులు పిల్లల బృందానికి సంక్లిష్టమైన భావనలను వివరించడానికి ఒకరితో ఒకరు పోటీపడతారు.

programme.title: ద ఫాస్ట్ హిస్టరీ ఆఫ్
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker sets on a fast-paced journey to look into the pasts of legendary companies to fascinating subjects like UFOs and the daily lives of billionaires
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు పురాణ కంపెనీల గతాన్ని పరిశీలించి, యూఎఫ్ఓలు, బిలియనీర్ల చరిత్రను తెలుసుకోడానికి ప్రయాణాన్ని ప్రారంభిస్తారు.

programme.title: ది అన్‌బిలీవబుల్ విత్ డాన్ అక్రాయిడ్
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker gives a comprehensive insight into the world's most peculiar stories from history, and diverse narratives from across various fields and cultures
programme.desc: వ్యాఖ్యాత డాన్ అక్రాయిడ్ యానిమేషన్ ద్వారా చరిత్రలోని ఎన్నో చిత్రవిచిత్రమైన, సమస్యాత్మక కథలను వివరిస్తారు.

programme.title: రాయల్ ఇండియా విత్ సమీరా
programme.sub-title: Renowned USA-based chef Samira Nanda explores the palaces of India in search of the culinary secrets of the nation's royal families

programme.title: टूर डी' रॉयल

programme.title: वर्ल्ड वॉर II वीथ टॉम हँक्स
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker sheds light on the story of Operation Barbarossa, Hitler's surprise invasion of the Soviet Union in 1941
programme.desc: Exploring WWII from Germany's invasion of Poland through the atomic age and examining pivotal battles, wartime leaders like Churchill and Roosevelt and the human cost of total war.

programme.title: पॉन स्टार्स

programme.desc: रामायण, मानव जाति के इतिहास में सबसे महान महाकाव्यों में से एक है तथा भारतीय मूल्यों, आदर्शों और जीवनशैली का आधार है, जो राम की यात्रा को दर्शाते हैं जिसमें उनके सद्गुणों ने बुराई पर विजय प्राप्त की।.

programme.desc: मोरारी बापू रामकथा के महत्वपूर्ण अंश पढ़ते और समझाते हैं, साथ ही उसकी अपनी व्याख्या और उसके महत्व पर प्रकाश डालते हैं।.

programme.title: योगऋषि स्वामी रामदेवजी महाराज
programme.sub-title: Baba Ramdev, a spiritual leader, delivers a discourse on spirituality and demonstrates various yoga asanas that enable oneself to lead a healthy and active lifestyle
programme.desc: आध्यात्मिक गुरु बाबा रामदेव आध्यात्मिकता पर प्रवचन देते हैं और विभिन्न योग आसनों का प्रदर्शन करते हैं जो स्वस्थ और सक्रिय जीवनशैली जीने में सक्षम बनाते हैं।.

programme.title: जतिन अग्रवाल जी
programme.sub-title: Jatin Agrawal Ji sings a series of soulful and melodious devotional songs in praise of the Almighty to foster a deep spiritual connection for the listeners
programme.desc: जतिन अग्रवाल जी सर्वशक्तिमान की स्तुति में हृदयस्पर्शी और मधुर भक्ति गीतों की एक श्रृंखला प्रस्तुत करते हैं, ताकि श्रोताओं के भीतर आध्यात्मिक जुड़ाव स्थापित हो सके।.

programme.title: महावीर शर्मा जी
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of devotional songs, hymns and sacred chants in praise of the Almighty is played back-to-back
programme.desc: ईश्वर की स्तुति में भक्ति गीतों, भजनों और पवित्र मंत्रों का व्यापक संकलन लगातार प्रस्तुत किया जाता है।.

programme.title: कृषण भैया सिरसा वाले
programme.sub-title: Bhaiya Krishan Das, a spiritual adept, reads passages and sacred verses from a religious text, explains their meaning and further sings hymns with the devotees
programme.desc: आध्यात्मिक गुरु भैया कृष्ण दास धार्मिक ग्रंथों से कुछ अंश और पवित्र श्लोक पढ़ते हुए उनका अर्थ समझाते हैं और भक्तों के साथ भजन गाते हैं।.

programme.title: मिनरल गुरु
programme.sub-title: Bringing the best in television
programme.desc: टेलीविजन के सर्वश्रेष्ठ कार्यक्रमों की प्रस्तुति।.

programme.title: संत रामपाल जी महाराज
programme.sub-title: Sant Rampal Ji Maharaj delivers a discourse based on sacred religious scriptures and imparts their significance among the followers
programme.desc: संत रामपाल जी महाराज पवित्र धार्मिक ग्रंथों पर आधारित प्रवचन देते हैं और अनुयायियों के बीच उनका महत्व बताते हैं।.

programme.title: जीसस कॉल
programme.sub-title: Religious leaders representing the church lead a session of prayer, after which devotees share their holistic experiences and the miracles they have witnessed
programme.desc: चर्च का प्रतिनिधित्व करने वाले धार्मिक गुरु एक प्रार्थना सत्र का नेतृत्व करते हैं, जिसके बाद अनुयायी अपने समग्र अनुभव और अपने द्वारा देखे गए चमत्कारों को साझा करते हैं।.

programme.title: राम नारायण राम
programme.sub-title: The host engages in illuminating dialogues with spiritual leaders, gaining vital knowledge about various religious concepts
programme.desc: प्रस्तुतकर्ता आध्यात्मिक गुरुओं के साथ ज्ञानवर्धक संवाद में संलग्न होते हैं, तथा विभिन्न धार्मिक अवधारणाओं के बारे में महत्वपूर्ण ज्ञान प्राप्त करते हैं।.

programme.title: भविष्य दर्पण
programme.sub-title: An astrologer reads the position of celestial objects and provides comprehensive predictions of the future for 12 zodiac signs
programme.desc: एक ज्योतिषी आकाशीय पिंडों की स्थिति को पढ़ते हैं और बारह राशियों के भविष्य के बारे में विस्तार से भविष्यवाणी करते हैं।.

programme.title: बाला जी सरकार
programme.sub-title: A religious leader sheds light on the teachings of the Almighty and encourages the followers to take the path of spirituality
programme.desc: एक धार्मिक पथप्रदर्शक ईश्वर की शिक्षाओं पर प्रकाश डालते हैं और अनुयायियों को आध्यात्मिकता का मार्ग अपनाने के लिए प्रोत्साहित करते हैं।.

programme.title: भाग्योदय
programme.sub-title: An astrology expert interprets celestial movements to provide insights into personalities, relationships and life events
programme.desc: एक ज्योतिष विशेषज्ञ व्यक्तित्व, रिश्तों और जीवन की घटनाओं के बारे में अंतर्दृष्टि प्रदान करने के लिए ग्रह-गोचरों की गतिविधियों की व्याख्या करते हैं।.

programme.title: दिव्य दृष्टि
programme.sub-title: A religious leader delivers a discourse on the teachings of the Almighty and guides devotees on the path of spirituality
programme.desc: एक धार्मिक पथ-प्रदर्शक सर्वशक्तिमान की शिक्षाओं पर प्रवचन देते हैं और भक्तों को आध्यात्मिकता के मार्ग पर चलने के लिए उनका मार्गदर्शन करते हैं।.

programme.title: आशु भाई गुरु जी
programme.sub-title: Ashu Bhai Guruji delivers a discourse on spiritualism and provides insights into astrology, enlightening devotees on their spiritual journey
programme.desc: आशु भाई गुरुजी अध्यात्म पर प्रवचन देते हैं और ज्योतिष की अंतर्दृष्टि प्रदान करते हैं, जिससे भक्तों को उनकी आध्यात्मिक यात्रा का ज्ञान मिलता है।.

programme.title: पीपी. अनिरुद्धाचार्य जी महाराज लाइव
programme.sub-title: A religious leader sheds light on the teachings of the Almighty and encourages the followers to take the path of spirituality, live

programme.desc: பொறுப்பற்ற இளைஞனான விஜயன், லட்சுமியைக் காதலிக்கிறான், ஆனால் தன் உணர்வுகளை வெளிப்படுத்த அவனுக்கு தைரியம் இல்லை.

credits.actor: Ramarajan,Sabitha Anand,S. S. Chandran,Senthil,S.N. Lakshmi,R Dilip,Chinni Jayanth

programme.desc: తన భూమిని అమ్మడానికి స్వస్థలానికి వచ్చిన రాము, ఒక అమ్మాయితో ప్రేమలో పడతాడు, కానీ ఆమె కుటుంబం అతన్ని చంపాలనుకుంటుంది.

programme.title: దేవీ కీర్తనలు
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive collection of soulful devotional melodies praising the Hindu deity Devi is played in order to enthrall the audience into seeking the deity's blessings
programme.desc: హిందువుల ఆరాధ్యదైవం దేవీని స్తుతించే ఆత్మీయ భక్తి శ్రావ్యమైన సమగ్రసంకలనం ప్రేక్షకులకు దేవుడి దీవెనలు పొందేలా చేస్తుంది.

programme.title: సంకట మోచన హనుమాన్
programme.sub-title: Lord Hanuman grows up to become a devout follower of Lord Rama and is fiercely loyal to him. He helps Lord Rama defeat Ravana, a wicked king
programme.desc: శ్రీరాముని పరమ భక్తుడైన హనుమంతుడు దుష్ట రాజు అయిన రావణాసురుడిని ఓడించటానికి శ్రీరామునికి సహాయం చేస్తాడు.

programme.title: వార్తలు
programme.sub-title: The host presents a comprehensive and detailed coverage, elucidating on the latest news and developments from across the region
programme.desc: వ్యాఖ్యాత స్థానిక ప్రాంతానికి చెందిన తాజా వార్తా విశేషాలు, పరిణామాల గురించి తెలుపుతూ, వివరణాత్మక విశ్లేషణ అందిస్తారు.

programme.title: ఓం నమః శివాయ
programme.sub-title: Religious leaders and devotees chant a powerful mantra sung in respect and adoration of Lord Shiva and seek his blessings

programme.title: వెలుగు నీడలు

programme.title: నివేదిత
programme.sub-title: Nivedita, a young married woman, discovers that she is HIV-positive due to her husband's unfaithfulness. Undeterred by criticism, she sets out to educate other women about the disease
programme.desc: తన భర్త కారణంగా తనకు ఎయిడ్స్ సోకిందని తెలుసుకున్న నివేదిత, విమర్శలకు భయపడకుండా, ఇతరులకు దానిపై అవగాహన కలిగిస్తుంది.

programme.title: పసిడిపంటలు

programme.title: ரகசிய கேள்விகள்
programme.sub-title: Renowned sexologist Dr Kamaraj provides expert advice on issues like impotency and erectile dysfunction, while offering treatment recommendations tailored to individual needs
programme.desc: பாலியல் நிபுணர் டாக்டர் காமராஜ்,ஆண்மைக்குறைவு-விறைப்புத்தன்மை பிரச்சினைகளில் ஆலோசனைகளை வழங்கி, பரிந்துரைகளை அளிக்கிறார்.

programme.title: திருவிளையாடல்
programme.sub-title: The story revolves around various events in the lives of Lord Shiva's devotees and the miracles performed by Lord Shiva, including the legendary story involving Dharumi, a poor poet
programme.desc: சிவபெருமானின் பக்தர்களின் வாழ்வில் நடந்த நிகழ்வுகள், ஏழை கவிஞரான தருமியின் கதை உட்பட சிவன் செய்த அற்புதங்கள் பற்றிய கதை.

credits.actor: Sivaji Ganesan,Savitri,K.B. Sundarambal,T. S. Balaiah,R. Muthuraman,Nagesh,T.R. Mahalingam,A.P. Nagarajan

programme.title: பொங்கு
programme.sub-title: Three salesmen decide to turn into thieves to earn a living when they lose their jobs after an expensive car gets robbed from their showroom
programme.desc: மூன்று விற்பனையாளர்கள் தங்கள் வேலைகள் இழக்கும் போது ஒரு நாடு சம்பாதிக்க திருடர்கள் திரும்ப முடிவு செய்கிறார்கள்.

credits.actor: Natarajan Subramaniam,Ruhi Singh,Manishaa Shree,Arjunan Nandakumar,Rajan Krishnaswamy,Sharath Lohitashwa,Pooja Bisht,Atul Kulkarni,Ramdoss

programme.title: அய்யா வழி சாங்க்ஸ்
programme.sub-title: Devotional artists and singers perform soulful hymns, celebrating Ayya Vaikundar, a 19th-century visionary and social reformer, inspiring faith and social change

programme.title: ரிலீஜியஸ் ப்ரோக்ராம்
programme.sub-title: A religious leader delivers a discourse on the teachings of the Almighty to enlighten the devotees and guide them on a path of spiritual growth
programme.desc: மத தலைவர் பக்தர்களுக்கு அறிவூட்டவும், ஆன்மீக பாதையில் வழிநடத்தவும் தேவனின் போதனைகள் குறித்த சொற்பொழிவை வழங்குகிறார்.

programme.title: சுப்ரபாதம்
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of devotional songs and hymns in praise of the divine written by various artists is played back-to-back
programme.desc: பல்வேறு கலைஞர்களால் எழுதப்பட்ட தெய்வீகத்தைப் போற்றும் பக்தி பாடல்கள் மேலும் கீர்த்தனைகள் தொடர்ச்சியாக இசைக்கப்படுகிறது.

programme.title: கந்தசஷ்டிக்கவசம்
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of religious hymns and devotional songs in praise of Lord Murugan written by various artists
programme.desc: பல்வேறு கலைஞர்களால் எழுதப்பட்ட அப்பன் முருகனைப் புகழ்ந்து மத பாடல்கள் மற்றும் பக்தி பாடல்களின் விரிவான தொகுப்பு.

programme.title: தினம் தினம் தரிசனம்
programme.sub-title: The host sheds light on the religious and spiritual significance of various Hindu temples and pilgrimage shrines across India
programme.desc: இந்தியா முழுவதும் உள்ள பல்வேறு இந்து கோவில்கள் மற்றும் புனித யாத்திரை தலங்களின் மத மற்றும் ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவம்.

programme.title: விஷ்ணு சஹஸ்ரநாமம்
programme.sub-title: Hindu religious leaders and devotees chant a Sanskrit hymn listing the 1,000 names of Lord Vishnu to seek his divine blessings
programme.desc: இந்து மதத் தலைவர்களும் பக்தர்களும் விஷ்ணுவின் 1,000 நாமங்களைக் கொண்ட சமஸ்கிருத பாடலைப் பாடுகிறார்கள்.

programme.title: ஜி‌கே‌பி / பி‌பி / டி‌டி‌எல்‌எம்
programme.sub-title: Bringing the best in television
programme.desc: தொலைக்காட்சியில் சிறந்ததைக் கொண்டுவருதல்.

programme.title: மதுரை காளியம்மன்
programme.sub-title: Priests and devotees gather at a pious shrine to offer their sincere prayers, worship the Almighty and seek divine blessings
programme.desc: பூசாரிகளும் பக்தர்களும் சன்னதியில் கூடி தங்கள் பிரார்த்தனைகளை வழங்கி, இறைவனை வணங்கி, தெய்வீக ஆசீகளைப் பெறுகிறார்கள்.

programme.title: விஷ்ணு ஷேத்திரம்
programme.sub-title: Priests and devotees assemble to perform a ceremonial ritual, offering worship and seeking the divine blessings of Lord Vishnu
programme.desc: பூசாரிகளும் பக்தர்களும் கூடி, ஒரு சடங்கு சடங்கை செய்து, வழிபாடு செய்து, விஷ்ணுவின் தெய்வீக ஆசீர்வாதத்தைப் பெறுகிறார்கள்.

programme.title: பக்தி பாடல்கள்
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of popular devotional songs in praise of deities performed by eminent artists is played back-to-back
programme.desc: புகழ்பெற்ற கலைஞர்களால் நடத்தப்படும் தெய்வங்களைப் போற்றும் பிரபலமான பக்திப் பாடல்கள் தொடர்ச்சியாக இசைக்கப்படுகிறது.

programme.title: சத்குரு
programme.sub-title: Sadhguru, a spiritual guru, gives a discourse on the teachings from the scriptures and urges his followers to walk on the path of righteousness
programme.desc: வேதங்களிலிருந்து போதனைகள் பற்றிய சொற்பொழிவை வழங்கி, பக்தர்களை நீதியின் பாதையில் செல்ல தூண்டும் ஆன்மீக குருவான சத்குரு.

programme.title: ஸ்ரீமத் பாகவதம்
programme.sub-title: A Hindu priest from Tirumala explains the chapters from Bhagavata Purana to the devotees of Lord Krishna in a detailed manner
programme.desc: ஆன்மீகத் தலைவர் ஆழ்ந்த ஞானத்தைப் பகிர்ந்து இந்து கடவுளான கிருஷ்ணரின் வாழ்க்கையை விவரிக்கும் தகவல் உரையை வழங்குகிறார்.

programme.title: அம்மன் கோவில்கள்
programme.sub-title: The host sheds light on the religious and cultural significance of various temples and shrines dedicated to Goddess Amman
programme.desc: தேவி அம்மனுக்கான பல்வேறு கோவில்கள் மற்றும் சன்னதிகளின் மத மற்றும் கலாச்சார முக்கியத்துவத்தை எடுத்துக்காட்டுகிறது.

programme.title: இஷ்ட தெய்வம்
programme.sub-title: Renowned individuals extensively discuss their faith and share experiences of divine providence and miracles in their personal lives
programme.desc: தங்கள் நம்பிக்கையை பற்றி பேசுவதோடு, அவர்களின் வாழ்வில் தெய்வீக நம்பிக்கை-அற்புதங்கள் பற்றிய அனுபவங்களை பகிரும் நபர்கள்.

programme.title: சிவாலயம்
programme.sub-title: At a revered temple in Kerala, priests and devotees unite in devotion, performing sacred rituals and offering heartfelt prayers to Lord Shiva
programme.desc: கேரளாவின் பிரபல கோவிலில், பூசாரிகள்-பக்தர்கள் இணைந்து, சடங்குகளை செய்து, சிவனுக்கு இதயப்பூர்வ வழிபாடுகளை செய்கிறார்கள்.

programme.title: கும்பாபிஷேகம்
programme.sub-title: Devotees in large numbers visit a temple to perform a special ritual in order to synergise and unite the special powers of the deity
programme.desc: தெய்வத்தின் சிறப்பு சக்திகளை ஒருங்கிணைக்கவும் ஒன்றிணைக்கவும் ஒரு சிறப்பு சடங்கை செய்ய பக்தர்கள் கோயிலுக்கு வருகிறார்கள்.

programme.title: ஆர்ஜேஆர் - ஹெர்பல் ஸ்லாட்
programme.sub-title: The host promotes the services offered by RJR Herbal Hospital, where patients receive Ayurvedic treatment to treat various health problems
programme.desc: நோயாளிகளுக்கு சிகிச்சையளிக்க ஆயுர்வேத சிகிச்சையை வழங்கும் ஆர்ஜேஆர் ஹெர்பல் மருத்துவமனை சேவைகளை விளம்பரப்படுத்துகிறது.

programme.title: பன்னிரு திருமுறை

programme.title: டகல்.காம்
programme.sub-title: Talented comedians enact various daily life scenarios, current events and socio-political issues with a hilarious twist
programme.desc: திறமையான நகைச்சுவை நடிகர்கள் பல்வேறு அன்றாட வாழ்க்கைக் காட்சிகள்-நிகழ்வுகள் நகைச்சுவையான திருப்பத்துடன் இயற்றுகின்றனர்.

programme.title: கானா பேட்டை
programme.sub-title: A group of talented youngsters and musicians perform a compilation of entertaining folk songs expressing various social themes
programme.desc: இளைஞர்கள்-இசைக்கலைஞர்கள் சமூக கருப்பொருள்களை வெளிப்படுத்தும் பொழுதுபோக்கு கிராமிய பாடல்களின் தொகுப்பை நிகழ்த்துகிறது.

programme.title: இஷ்ட தெய்வம்
programme.sub-title: Renowned individuals extensively discuss their faith and share experiences of divine providence and miracles in their personal lives
programme.desc: தங்கள் நம்பிக்கையை பற்றி பேசுவதோடு, அவர்களின் வாழ்வில் தெய்வீக நம்பிக்கை-அற்புதங்கள் பற்றிய அனுபவங்களை பகிரும் நபர்கள்.

programme.title: ரிலீஜியஸ் ப்ரோக்ராம்
programme.sub-title: A religious leader delivers a discourse on the teachings of the Almighty to enlighten the devotees and guide them on a path of spiritual growth
programme.desc: மத தலைவர் பக்தர்களுக்கு அறிவூட்டவும், ஆன்மீக பாதையில் வழிநடத்தவும் தேவனின் போதனைகள் குறித்த சொற்பொழிவை வழங்குகிறார்.

programme.title: சுப்ரபாதம்
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of devotional songs and hymns in praise of the divine written by various artists is played back-to-back
programme.desc: பல்வேறு கலைஞர்களால் எழுதப்பட்ட தெய்வீகத்தைப் போற்றும் பக்தி பாடல்கள் மேலும் கீர்த்தனைகள் தொடர்ச்சியாக இசைக்கப்படுகிறது.

programme.title: கந்தசஷ்டிக்கவசம்
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of religious hymns and devotional songs in praise of Lord Murugan written by various artists
programme.desc: பல்வேறு கலைஞர்களால் எழுதப்பட்ட அப்பன் முருகனைப் புகழ்ந்து மத பாடல்கள் மற்றும் பக்தி பாடல்களின் விரிவான தொகுப்பு.

programme.title: தினம் தினம் தரிசனம்
programme.sub-title: The host sheds light on the religious and spiritual significance of various Hindu temples and pilgrimage shrines across India
programme.desc: இந்தியா முழுவதும் உள்ள பல்வேறு இந்து கோவில்கள் மற்றும் புனித யாத்திரை தலங்களின் மத மற்றும் ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவம்.

programme.title: விஷ்ணு சஹஸ்ரநாமம்
programme.sub-title: Hindu religious leaders and devotees chant a Sanskrit hymn listing the 1,000 names of Lord Vishnu to seek his divine blessings
programme.desc: இந்து மதத் தலைவர்களும் பக்தர்களும் விஷ்ணுவின் 1,000 நாமங்களைக் கொண்ட சமஸ்கிருத பாடலைப் பாடுகிறார்கள்.

programme.title: ஜி‌கே‌பி / பி‌பி / டி‌டி‌எல்‌எம்
programme.sub-title: Bringing the best in television
programme.desc: தொலைக்காட்சியில் சிறந்ததைக் கொண்டுவருதல்.

programme.title: மதுரை காளியம்மன்
programme.sub-title: Priests and devotees gather at a pious shrine to offer their sincere prayers, worship the Almighty and seek divine blessings
programme.desc: பூசாரிகளும் பக்தர்களும் சன்னதியில் கூடி தங்கள் பிரார்த்தனைகளை வழங்கி, இறைவனை வணங்கி, தெய்வீக ஆசீகளைப் பெறுகிறார்கள்.

programme.title: விஷ்ணு ஷேத்திரம்
programme.sub-title: Priests and devotees assemble to perform a ceremonial ritual, offering worship and seeking the divine blessings of Lord Vishnu
programme.desc: பூசாரிகளும் பக்தர்களும் கூடி, ஒரு சடங்கு சடங்கை செய்து, வழிபாடு செய்து, விஷ்ணுவின் தெய்வீக ஆசீர்வாதத்தைப் பெறுகிறார்கள்.

programme.title: பக்தி பாடல்கள்
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of popular devotional songs in praise of deities performed by eminent artists is played back-to-back
programme.desc: புகழ்பெற்ற கலைஞர்களால் நடத்தப்படும் தெய்வங்களைப் போற்றும் பிரபலமான பக்திப் பாடல்கள் தொடர்ச்சியாக இசைக்கப்படுகிறது.

programme.title: சத்குரு
programme.sub-title: Sadhguru, a spiritual guru, gives a discourse on the teachings from the scriptures and urges his followers to walk on the path of righteousness
programme.desc: வேதங்களிலிருந்து போதனைகள் பற்றிய சொற்பொழிவை வழங்கி, பக்தர்களை நீதியின் பாதையில் செல்ல தூண்டும் ஆன்மீக குருவான சத்குரு.

programme.title: ஸ்ரீமத் பாகவதம்

programme.desc: கேரளாவின் பிரபல கோவிலில், பூசாரிகள்-பக்தர்கள் இணைந்து, சடங்குகளை செய்து, சிவனுக்கு இதயப்பூர்வ வழிபாடுகளை செய்கிறார்கள்.

programme.title: டகல்.காம்
programme.sub-title: Talented comedians enact various daily life scenarios, current events and socio-political issues with a hilarious twist
programme.desc: திறமையான நகைச்சுவை நடிகர்கள் பல்வேறு அன்றாட வாழ்க்கைக் காட்சிகள்-நிகழ்வுகள் நகைச்சுவையான திருப்பத்துடன் இயற்றுகின்றனர்.

programme.title: கானா பேட்டை
programme.sub-title: A group of talented youngsters and musicians perform a compilation of entertaining folk songs expressing various social themes
programme.desc: இளைஞர்கள்-இசைக்கலைஞர்கள் சமூக கருப்பொருள்களை வெளிப்படுத்தும் பொழுதுபோக்கு கிராமிய பாடல்களின் தொகுப்பை நிகழ்த்துகிறது.

programme.title: இஷ்ட தெய்வம்
programme.sub-title: Renowned individuals extensively discuss their faith and share experiences of divine providence and miracles in their personal lives
programme.desc: தங்கள் நம்பிக்கையை பற்றி பேசுவதோடு, அவர்களின் வாழ்வில் தெய்வீக நம்பிக்கை-அற்புதங்கள் பற்றிய அனுபவங்களை பகிரும் நபர்கள்.

programme.title: ரிலீஜியஸ் ப்ரோக்ராம்
programme.sub-title: A religious leader delivers a discourse on the teachings of the Almighty to enlighten the devotees and guide them on a path of spiritual growth
programme.desc: மத தலைவர் பக்தர்களுக்கு அறிவூட்டவும், ஆன்மீக பாதையில் வழிநடத்தவும் தேவனின் போதனைகள் குறித்த சொற்பொழிவை வழங்குகிறார்.

programme.title: சுப்ரபாதம்
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of devotional songs and hymns in praise of the divine written by various artists is played back-to-back
programme.desc: பல்வேறு கலைஞர்களால் எழுதப்பட்ட தெய்வீகத்தைப் போற்றும் பக்தி பாடல்கள் மேலும் கீர்த்தனைகள் தொடர்ச்சியாக இசைக்கப்படுகிறது.

programme.title: கந்தசஷ்டிக்கவசம்
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of religious hymns and devotional songs in praise of Lord Murugan written by various artists
programme.desc: பல்வேறு கலைஞர்களால் எழுதப்பட்ட அப்பன் முருகனைப் புகழ்ந்து மத பாடல்கள் மற்றும் பக்தி பாடல்களின் விரிவான தொகுப்பு.

programme.title: தினம் தினம் தரிசனம்
programme.sub-title: The host sheds light on the religious and spiritual significance of various Hindu temples and pilgrimage shrines across India
programme.desc: இந்தியா முழுவதும் உள்ள பல்வேறு இந்து கோவில்கள் மற்றும் புனித யாத்திரை தலங்களின் மத மற்றும் ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவம்.

programme.title: விஷ்ணு சஹஸ்ரநாமம்
programme.sub-title: Hindu religious leaders and devotees chant a Sanskrit hymn listing the 1,000 names of Lord Vishnu to seek his divine blessings
programme.desc: இந்து மதத் தலைவர்களும் பக்தர்களும் விஷ்ணுவின் 1,000 நாமங்களைக் கொண்ட சமஸ்கிருத பாடலைப் பாடுகிறார்கள்.

programme.title: ஜி‌கே‌பி / பி‌பி / டி‌டி‌எல்‌எம்
programme.sub-title: Bringing the best in television
programme.desc: தொலைக்காட்சியில் சிறந்ததைக் கொண்டுவருதல்.

programme.title: மதுரை காளியம்மன்
programme.sub-title: Priests and devotees gather at a pious shrine to offer their sincere prayers, worship the Almighty and seek divine blessings
programme.desc: பூசாரிகளும் பக்தர்களும் சன்னதியில் கூடி தங்கள் பிரார்த்தனைகளை வழங்கி, இறைவனை வணங்கி, தெய்வீக ஆசீகளைப் பெறுகிறார்கள்.

programme.title: விஷ்ணு ஷேத்திரம்

programme.title: பக்தி பாடல்கள்

programme.sub-title: Max, a bionic guinea pig, and his goldfish best friend embark on fascinating adventures after they escape the laboratory and try to fit in the wildlife
programme.desc: एक बायोनिक गिनी पिग, मैक्स और उसके सुनहरी मछली का सबसे अच्छा दोस्त, प्रयोगशाला से भागने और वन्य जीवन में फिट होने की कोशिश करने के बाद आकर्षक रोमांच पर निकलते हैं।.

programme.desc: रबर से बना एक युवक मंकी डी लफी और उसके समुद्री डाकुओं की टीम एक काल्पनिक खजाने को खोजने के लिए एक रोमांचक एडवेंचर पर निकल पड़ते हैं।.

programme.title: कितेरेत्सु

programme.title: बायोनिक मैक्स
programme.sub-title: Max, a bionic guinea pig, and his goldfish best friend embark on fascinating adventures after they escape the laboratory and try to fit in the wildlife
programme.desc: एक बायोनिक गिनी पिग, मैक्स और उसके सुनहरी मछली का सबसे अच्छा दोस्त, प्रयोगशाला से भागने और वन्य जीवन में फिट होने की कोशिश करने के बाद आकर्षक रोमांच पर निकलते हैं।.

programme.title: हन्टर एक्स हन्टर
programme.sub-title: Gon Freecss sets out to become a Hunter, an elite professional known for hunting rare monsters and treasures, in the hopes of finding his absent father
programme.desc: गॉन फ्रीक्स अपने गायब पिता को खोजने की आशा एक शिकारी बनने का निश्चय करता है, जो एक विशिष्ट पेशेवर है तथा दुर्लभ राक्षसों और खजानों का शिकार करने के लिए जाना जाता है।.

programme.title: वन पीस
programme.sub-title: Monkey D Luffy, a young man made of rubber, and his team of pirates embark on an exciting adventure to find a fabled treasure
programme.desc: रबर से बना एक युवक मंकी डी लफी और उसके समुद्री डाकुओं की टीम एक काल्पनिक खजाने को खोजने के लिए एक रोमांचक एडवेंचर पर निकल पड़ते हैं।.

credits.actor: Mayumi Tanaka (Monkey D Luffy),Kazuya Nakai (Roronoa Zoro),Akemi Okamura (Nami),Kappei Yamaguchi (Usopp),Hiroaki Hirata (Sanji),Mahito Ôba

programme.title: कितेरेत्सु
programme.sub-title: Kiteretsu, an elementary school student who uses his inventions to help people, and Korosuke, his robot, partake in various adventures along with his friends
programme.desc: कितेरेत्सु, एक प्राथमिक विद्यालय का छात्र है जो लोगों की मदद करने के लिए अपने आविष्कारों का उपयोग करता है, और कोरोसुके, उसका रोबोट, अपने दोस्तों के साथ विभिन्न साहसिक कार्यों में भाग लेते हैं।.

credits.actor: Toshiko Fujita (Kiteretsu),Kazuko Sugiyama (Korosuke),Chieko Honda (Miyo),Yuji Mitsuya (Tongari),Mami Koyama (Korosuke),Mayumi Sho (Miyo)

programme.title: वी बेर बीयर्स
programme.sub-title: Three brother bears, Grizzly, Panda, and Ice, awkwardly navigate life in the San Francisco Bay Area as they try to fit into modern human society
programme.desc: तीन भालू भाई, ग्रिजली, पांडा और आइस, सैन फ्रांसिस्को खाड़ी क्षेत्र में जीवन को अजीब तरीके से जीते हैं, जब वे आधुनिक मानव समाज में घुलने की कोशिश करते हैं।.

credits.actor: Bobby Moynihan (Panda),Eric Edelstein (Grizzly),Demetri Martin (Ice Bear),Charlyne Yi (Chloe),Patton Oswalt (Nom Nom),Jason Lee (Charlie)

programme.desc: தமிழ்நாட்டிலிருந்து சில முக்கியமான அரசியல் செய்திகள் மற்றும் புதுப்பிப்புகள் குறித்த நையாண்டியாக வழங்கும் தொகுப்பாளர்.

programme.title: டாப் நியூஸ்

programme.desc: அரசியல், குற்றம், சமூக-பொருளாதார பிரச்சினைகள், நடப்பு விவகாரங்கள் போன்ற துறைகளில் செய்திகள் மற்றும் புதுப்பிப்புகள்.

programme.title: ஆயுத எழுத்து
programme.sub-title: Kaliammal, a bold and manipulative woman, tries to keep the village under her fist. However, Indra, a young and ambitious sub-collector, vows to put an end to Kaliammal's evil regime
programme.desc: தனது கட்டுப்பாட்டில் கிராமத்தை கையாள நினைக்கும் தைரியமான காளியம்மாளின் ஆட்சிக்கு முடிவுக்கட்டும் துணை கலெக்டரான இந்திரா.

programme.title: குறிஞ்சி
programme.sub-title: When circumstances compel an ambitious woman to wed a man with a tough personality, their initial friction slowly gives way to mutual understanding and eventually love
programme.desc: சூழ்நிலைகளின் நிர்ப்பந்தத்தால், லட்சியம் மிக்க ஒரு பெண், கடின குணமுடைய ஒரு ஆணை மணக்கிறாள். ஆரம்பகால முரண்பாடுகள் படிப்படியாக மறைந்து, பரஸ்பர புரிதலுக்கும் இறுதியில் காதலுக்கும் வழிவகுக்கிறது.

programme.title: அபிராமி
programme.sub-title: Abirami, a loving mother and devoted wife, places her family's happiness above all else. After enduring endless disrespect, she, with her daughter's support, sets out to rebuild her life
programme.desc: அன்பான தாயும் மனைவியுமான அபிராமி, தன் குடும்பத்தின் மகிழ்ச்சிக்கே முன்னுரிமை அளிக்கிறாள். எனினும், தொடர் அவமரியாதைகளை சந்தித்த பின், அவள் தன் மகளின் ஆதரவுடன் தன் வாழ்க்கையை மீண்டும் புதிதாகத் தொடங்குகிறாள்.

programme.title: சிறகுகள்
programme.sub-title: While weathering deep family turmoil, fate brings Dharmadurai and Parvathi together as they navigate greed and betrayal
programme.desc: கடினமான குடும்பச் சிக்கல்களைச் சமாளிக்கும் வேளையில், பேராசையையும் துரோகத்தையும் எதிர்கொள்ளும் தர்மதுரையையும் பார்வதியையும் விதி ஒன்று சேர்க்கிறது.

programme.title: இருமலர்கள்
programme.sub-title: Bringing the best in television
programme.desc: தொலைக்காட்சியில் சிறந்ததைக் கொண்டுவருதல்.

programme.title: லக்ஷ்மி
programme.sub-title: Maha, her family's primary breadwinner, wants to keep supporting her family even after marrying Selvam. However, things become complicated as obstacles test their family bonds and marriage
programme.desc: மகா செல்வத்தை திருமணம் செய்தபிறகும், தாய் வீட்டை ஆதரிக்க நினைக்கும்போது, தடைகளால் அவர்களின் குடும்பத்தில் சிக்கலானது.

programme.title: மூவி டு பி அனௌன்ஸ்ட்
programme.sub-title: Bringing the best in cinema
programme.desc: இந்நிகழ்ச்சி சினிமாவில் மிகவும் சிறந்தவைகளைக் கொண்டுவருகின்றது.

programme.title: நியூஸ்
programme.sub-title: The host provides the latest information, advancements, and developments regarding various political, economic and social issues
programme.desc: அரசியல், பொருளாதார மற்றும் சமூகப் பிரச்சினைகள் தொடர்பான சமீபத்திய தகவல்கள், முன்னேற்றங்கள் மற்றும் முன்னேற்றங்கள்.

programme.title: அன்னம்
programme.sub-title: Annam, a bright and cheerful young woman, faces the challenges of life while withstanding the harsh treatment from her stepmother
programme.desc: மகிழ்ச்சியான இளம் பெண் அன்னம், தனது மாற்றாந்தாயின் கொடுமைகளை சகித்துக்கொண்டு வாழ்க்கையின் சவால்களை எதிர்கொள்கிறார்.

programme.title: பைரவி
programme.sub-title: Following the tragedy that claimed her family, Bhairavi's life falls apart as she begins anew in an uninviting house and job. But her aim to uncover the reality of the incident drives her onward
programme.desc: தன் குடும்பத்தை பறித்த துயர சம்பவத்தால் பைரவியின் வாழ்க்கை சிதறுகிறது. அன்னியமான வீட்டிலும் புதிய வேலையிலும் தன் வாழ்வைத் தொடங்கும் அவள், அந்தச் சம்பவத்தின் உண்மைகளைக் கண்டறியும் இலக்கோடு தொடர்ந்து முன்னோக்கிப் பயணிக்கிறாள்.

programme.title: மருமகள்
programme.sub-title: Prabhu is a miser and puts his needs ahead of his family. Circumstances bring him closer to Aadhirai, who helps others selflessly
programme.desc: பிரபு, தன் குடும்பத்தை விட தன் தேவைகளுக்கு முன்னுரிமை அளிக்கிறான். ஆதிரையிடம் தன்னலமின்றி மற்றவர்களுக்கு உதவுகிறாள்.

programme.title: மூன்று முடிச்சு
programme.sub-title: Nandini, a vivacious girl, gets married to Suryakumar, a businessman. However, the couple strives to navigate their relationship along with balancing familial responsibilities
programme.desc: தொழிலதிபர் சூர்யகுமாரை மணக்கும் சுறுசுறுப்பான நந்தினி,இருவரும் குடும்ப பொறுப்புகளின் மூலம் உறவை வழிநடத்த முயலுகிறார்கள்.

credits.actor: Swathi Konde,Prabhakaran Chandran,Krithika Laddu,Niyaz Khan,Preethi Sanjiv

programme.title: சிங்கப்பெண்ணே
programme.sub-title: Anandi, a village belle, embarks on a solo journey to fulfil her duties as a daughter and shoulder the responsibilities of her family
programme.desc: ஒரு மகளாக தனது கடமைகளை நிறைவேற்றவும், தனது குடும்பத்தின் பொறுப்புகளை சுமப்பதற்காகவும் ஒரு பயணத்தை தொடங்கும் ஆனந்தி.

credits.actor: Darshak Gowda,Amaljith,G. Gnanasambandam,Rama,Chandrakanth,Lakshmi Raj,VJ Bavithra,Maneesha Mahesh

programme.title: எதிர்நீச்சல் தொடர்கிறது
programme.sub-title: Janani and the women of the household embark on a journey to pursue their ambitions in the wake of Aadhimuthu Gunasekaran's downfall, while navigating the challenges of society
programme.desc: ஜனனியும் வீட்டுப் பெண்களும் ஆதிமுத்து குணசேகரனின் வீழ்ச்சியைத் தொடர்ந்து, ​​தங்கள் லட்சிய பயணத்தைத் தொடங்குகின்றனர்.

credits.actor: Madhumitha Hirannaiah,Kaniha,Haripriya Isai,Vela Ramamoorthy,Sabari Prasanth,Vibhu Raman

programme.title: மல்லி
programme.sub-title: Adi Kesava experiences a tragedy, after which he takes in Mallika for his son. However, will Mallika be able to adjust in her new family?
programme.desc: ஆதி கேசவா என்பவர் ஒரு துயர சம்பவத்தை சந்திக்கிறார், அதன் பிறகு மல்லிகாவை தனது மகனுக்காக ஏற்றுக்கொள்கிறார்.

credits.actor: Sirisha Sougandh,Roopa Reddy,Bhavana Lasya,Aryan Dhir Kumar,Nanda Kishore,Jayasri Raj

programme.title: இருமலர்கள்
programme.sub-title: Bringing the best in television
programme.desc: தொலைக்காட்சியில் சிறந்ததைக் கொண்டுவருதல்.

programme.title: புது வசந்தம்
programme.sub-title: While the parents search for a suitable prospect for their daughter Selvi's marriage, she expresses her desire to get married to a joint family
programme.desc: பெற்றோர் தனக்கு திருமணத்திற்கு வரன் தேடும்போது, கூட்டுக் குடும்பத்தில் திருமணம் செய்ய விருப்பம் தெரிவிக்கும் செல்வி.

programme.title: కమర్షియల్
programme.sub-title: The host shares information about a wide selection of products that can be purchased from the comfort of the consumer's home
programme.desc: వ్యాఖ్యాత, ఇంటినుండే సౌకర్యవంతంగా కొనుగోలు చేయగల ప్రముఖ సంస్థలకు చెందిన ఉత్పత్తుల ప్రత్యేకతలను తెలియచేస్తారు.

programme.title: నవగ్రహ స్తోత్రం
programme.sub-title: Devotees chant the 'Navagraha Stotram', a hymn dedicated to the nine celestial bodies and deities that influence human life
programme.desc: భక్తులు మానవ జీవితాన్ని ప్రభావితం చేసే తొమ్మిది గ్రహాలు, దేవతలకు అంకితం చేయబడిన నవగ్రహ స్తోత్రాన్ని జపిస్తారు.

programme.title: ప్రతి రోజు గీతా శ్లోకం
programme.sub-title: A religious leader delivers a discourse on the important sacred verses from the Shrimad Bhagavad Gita and explains their meaning to the devotees
programme.desc: ఒక ఆధ్యాత్మిక గురువు, భగవద్గీతలోని పవిత్ర శ్లోకాలపై ఉపన్యాసం అందించి, భక్తులకు వాటి అర్థాన్ని వివరిస్తారు.

programme.title: సౌందర్య లహరి
programme.sub-title: A prominent personality provides detailed insights into Saundarya Lahari, a renowned literary creation by a Vedic scholar
programme.desc: ఒక ప్రముఖ వ్యక్తి ఒక వేద పండితునిచే రచించబడిన ప్రఖ్యాత సాహిత్య సృష్టి అయిన సౌందర్య లహరి గురించి తెలుపుతారు.

programme.title: అన్నమయ్య సంకీర్తన లహరి
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive collection of Telugu devotional songs composed and written by Annamacharya, a Hindu saint, is played back-to-back
programme.desc: హిందూ సాధువు అన్నమాచార్య స్వరపరిచిన, రచించిన తెలుగు భక్తి గీతాల సమగ్ర సేకరణను త్వరితగతిన ప్రసారం చేస్తారు.

programme.title: శ్రీ విష్ణు సహస్రనామ స్తోత్రం
programme.sub-title: Devotees recite the Sri Vishnu Sahasranama Stotram, in the name of Lord Vishnu to seek blessings and lead a better prosperous life
programme.desc: భక్తులు మెరుగైన, సంపన్న జీవితాన్ని ప్రసాదించమని కోరుతూ, విష్ణువు నామాలతో కూడిన విష్ణు సహస్రనామ స్తోత్రాన్ని పఠిస్తారు.

programme.title: శ్రీ లలితా సహస్రనామ స్తోత్రం
programme.sub-title: Professional singers perform a rendition of a devotional song, reciting the thousand names of Goddess Lalita, seeking her blessings
programme.desc: వృత్తిపరమైన గాయకులు లలితాదేవి వెయ్యి నామాలను పఠిస్తూ భక్తి గీతాన్ని ఆలపిస్తూ, ఆమె ఆశీర్వాదాలు కోరుకుంటారు.

programme.title: గణపతి స్తోత్రం
programme.sub-title: Several devotees gather to chant the Ganpati Stotram, a devotional chant, in praise of Lord Ganesha and seek his blessings
programme.desc: అనేకమంది భక్తులు కలిసి భక్తి శ్లోకమైన గణపతి స్తోత్రంతో వినాయకుడిని ఆరాధిస్తూ, స్వామి ఆశీర్వాదాలు కోరతారు.

programme.title: యాదాద్రి సుప్రభాతం
programme.sub-title: Hindu priests and devotees chant a comprehensive compilation of hymns in praise of Yadagiri Laxmi Narasimha Swamy to seek the blessings of the Almighty
programme.desc: పండితులు, భక్తులు యాదగిరి లక్ష్మీ నరసింహస్వామిని స్తుతిస్తూ ఆయన దీవెనలు పొందేందుకు కీర్తనల సంకలనాన్ని పఠిస్తారు.

programme.title: కాకడ హారతి
programme.sub-title: Religious leaders and devotees gather together to sing devotional hymns and perform sacred rituals in honour of Shirdi Sai Baba
programme.desc: షిర్డీ సాయిబాబా గౌరవార్థం ఆధ్యాత్మిక గురువులు, భక్తులు ఒకచోట చేరి శ్లోకాలు పఠిస్తూ, పవిత్రమైన ఆచారాలను నిర్వహిస్తారు.

programme.title: గణపతి స్తోత్రం

programme.title: కాకడ హారతి

programme.title: కళ్యాణ ప్రాప్తిరస్తు

programme.title: చాగంటి వారి ప్రవచనం
programme.sub-title: A religious speaker delivers a discourse based on the sacred texts from the holy scriptures and imparts significant teachings to his followers

programme.title: సాయి చాలీసా
programme.sub-title: Devotees chant verses while offering prayers to Sai Baba to invoke his blessings and grace to help them lead a peaceful life
programme.desc: భక్తులు సాయిబాబా ఆశీస్సులు, కృపను కోరుతూ, ప్రశాంతమైన జీవితాన్ని గడపడానికి సహాయం చేయమని ప్రార్థనలు చేస్తారు.

programme.title: గోవింద నామాలు
programme.sub-title: Devotees chant holy verses from religious scriptures to offer respects and praise a revered Hindu deity, Lord Venkateswara
programme.desc: భక్తులు హిందూ దేవుడైన వేంకటేశ్వర స్వామిని ఆరాధిస్తూ, ఆయనను గౌరవిస్తూ మత గ్రంథాలలోని పవిత్ర శ్లోకాలను పఠిస్తారు.

programme.title: లలితా సహస్రనామ స్తోత్రమ్
programme.sub-title: Devotees sing a melodious rendition of the 'Lalita Sahasranama Stotram', a hymn that extols the virtues of Goddess Lalita Devi
programme.desc: హిందూ భక్తులు లలితా దేవి సద్గుణాలను కీర్తిస్తూ 'లలితా సహస్రనామ స్తోత్రమ్' శ్రావ్యమైన కూర్పును పఠిస్తారు.

programme.title: సాయి సహస్రనామం
programme.sub-title: Religious leaders chant the Sai Sahasranamam, a devotional hymn comprising a thousand revered names of Sai Baba of Shirdi, to invoke his blessings and divine grace

programme.title: సాయి మంత్రం

programme.title: సాయి నామాలు

programme.title: अवेकनिंग विथ ब्रह्माकुमारिज
programme.sub-title: The host speaks to a Brahma Kumari about topics of religious and spiritual interest that can help one attain peace and become a better person
programme.desc: एक आध्यात्मिक पथप्रदर्शक ध्यान के महत्व तथा मन, शरीर और प्रार्थना के बीच संबंध पर विस्तृत तरीके से प्रवचन प्रदान करते हैं।.

programme.title: रूह रिहान
programme.sub-title: A spiritual expert offers profound insights into life's challenges, guiding towards self-realisation, peace and personal growth through deep spiritual understanding
programme.desc: एक आध्यात्मिक पथप्रदर्शक, जीवन की चुनौतियों के बारे में गहन अंतर्दृष्टि प्रदान करते हैं, तथा आध्यात्मिक समझ के माध्यम से आत्म-साक्षात्कार, शांति और व्यक्तिगत विकास की दिशा में मार्गदर्शन करते हैं।.

programme.sub-title: A Brahma Kumari sheds light on various spiritual concepts surrounding karma, destiny and choice whilst emphasising the significance of leading a peaceful life

programme.sub-title: The host speaks to a Brahma Kumari about topics of religious and spiritual interest that can help one attain peace and become a better person

programme.title: अमृतवेला
programme.sub-title: The narrator walks one through a guided meditation designed specially for early morning, so that a yogic practitioner may begin the day on a tranquil and mindful note
programme.desc: एक आध्यात्मिक पथप्रदर्शक, गुरु ग्रंथ साहिब से कीर्तनों के व्यापक संकलन के माध्यम से प्रार्थना में मण्डली का मार्गदर्शन करते हैं।.

programme.title: वर्ड्स ऑफ विजडम
programme.sub-title: Spiritual scholars and revered pundits share insights from their life experiences and spiritual journeys to guide individuals on the path of righteousness

programme.sub-title: An expert demonstrates a set of mindful exercises for nurturing the body, as it is infinitely important to nourish the vessel that houses the mind

programme.desc: धार्मिक पथप्रदर्शक और भक्तजन भजन गाते हैं और भगवान कृष्ण से सच्चे मन से प्रार्थना करते हुए उनका दिव्य आशीर्वाद मांगते हैं।.

programme.title: डिवोशनल मेलोज़

programme.desc: भक्ति भजनों और गीतों का एक व्यापक संकलन प्रस्तुत किया जाता है, जिसमें ईश्वर की स्तुति की जाती है और दिव्य आशीर्वाद की कामना की जाती है।.

programme.title: जॉय ऑफ कृष्णा कान्शसनस
programme.sub-title: Religious leaders and devotees sing devotional songs and offer their sincere prayers to Lord Krishna, seeking his divine blessings
programme.desc: धार्मिक पथप्रदर्शक और भक्तजन भजन गाते हैं और भगवान कृष्ण से सच्चे मन से प्रार्थना करते हुए उनका दिव्य आशीर्वाद मांगते हैं।.

programme.title: डिवोशनल मेलोज़
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of devotional hymns and songs are played back to back, praising the Almighty and seeking divine blessings
programme.desc: भक्ति भजनों और गीतों का एक व्यापक संकलन प्रस्तुत किया जाता है, जिसमें ईश्वर की स्तुति की जाती है और दिव्य आशीर्वाद की कामना की जाती है।.

programme.title: சிங்கப்பூர் சலூன்
programme.sub-title: In a small village, friends Kathir and Basheer dream big. Inspired by Sacha, the local salon owner, Kathir sets his sights on becoming a hairdresser
programme.desc: ஒரு சிறிய கிராமத்தில் ஒரு சிகையலங்காரரான சாச்சாவால் ஈர்க்கப்பட்டு அவரை போல ஹேர்ஸ்டைலிஸ்டாக மாற விரும்பும் கதிர்.

credits.actor: RJ Balaji,Lokesh Kanagaraj,Lal,Sathyaraj,Meenakshii Chaudhary,Jiiva,Shivani Rajashekar,John Vijay,Ann Sheetal

programme.title: இந்தவார கலகலப்பு
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of hilarious comedy scenes, featuring popular artists, is played back-to-back for the entertainment of the viewers
programme.desc: கலைஞர்கள் பங்கேற்கும் நகைச்சுவைக் காட்சிகளின் தொகுப்பு பார்வையாளர்களின் பொழுதுபோக்கிற்காக தொடர்ச்சியாக இசைக்கப்படுகிறது.

programme.title: பிடிச்சிருக்கு
programme.sub-title: Vel is a humble boy who meets Manju accidentally and falls in love with her. But their new-found happiness is short-lived when Manju's father discovers their secret love
programme.desc: தற்செயலாக சந்தித்து தான் காதலிக்கும் மஞ்சுவுடனான வேலின் காதல், அவளின் தந்தை தங்களை பற்றி அறிந்ததும் சிக்கலடைகிறது.

programme.title: சாங்க்ஸ்
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of popular and famous songs produced and composed by talented musical artists is played back-to-back
programme.desc: திறமையான இசைக் கலைஞர்கள் தயாரித்து இசையமைத்த பிரபலமான பாடல்களின் தொகுப்பு அடுத்தடுத்து இசைக்கப்படுகிறது.

programme.title: தேனும் பாலும்
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of melodious songs composed by renowned musicians and performed by various artists in Tamil movies played back to back
programme.desc: புகழ்பெற்ற இசைக்கலைஞர்களால் இசையமைக்கப்பட்டு, தமிழ் திரைப்படங்களில் பல்வேறு கலைஞர்கள் நிகழ்த்திய மெல்லிசை பாடல்கள்.

programme.title: ராமானுஜர்
programme.sub-title: Ramanuja, a learned philosopher, travels the subcontinent and brings his teachings to ardent followers of the Hindu faith
programme.desc: கற்றறிந்த தத்துவஞானியான ராமானுஜம் நாடு முழுதும் சென்று இந்து மதத்தின் தீவிரப் பக்தர்களுக்கு தனது போதனைகளை கற்பிக்கிறார்.

programme.title: ஸ்லாட்
programme.sub-title: Bringing the best in television
programme.desc: இந்நிகழ்ச்சி தொலைக்காட்சியில் மிகவும் சிறந்ததைக் கொண்டுவருகிறது.

programme.title: ஏஆர்சி இன்டர்நேஷனல்
programme.sub-title: Bringing the best in television
programme.desc: தொலைக்காட்சியில் சிறந்ததைக் கொண்டுவருதல்.

programme.title: நியூஸ்
programme.sub-title: The host presents the latest news stories and developments pertaining to various political and socio-economic issues around the country
programme.desc: நாடு முழுவதும் உள்ள பல அரசியல் மற்றும் சமூக-பொருளாதார பிரச்சினைகள் தொடர்பான சமீபத்திய செய்திகள் மற்றும் முன்னேற்றங்கள்.

programme.title: விடியலே வா
programme.sub-title: The host provides information on various trending topics related to fitness, technology, finance, society, economy and culture and interviews experts on them
programme.desc: உடற்பயிற்சி, தொழில்நுட்பம், நிதி, சமூகம், பொருளாதாரம் மற்றும் கலாச்சாரம் தொடர்பான பல்வேறு தலைப்புகள் குறித்த தகவல்கள்.

programme.title: ஸ்நேகிதியே
programme.sub-title: The host engages in discussions on topics related to women's issues, along with home and lifestyle tips
programme.desc: வீடு மற்றும் வாழ்க்கை முறை குறிப்புகளுடன் பெண்களின் பிரச்சினைகள் தொடர்பான தலைப்புகளில் விவாதங்களில் ஈடுபடுகிறது.

programme.title: அழகி
programme.sub-title: Sundari, a widow, raises her three children, Natraj, Mathi and Surya with love and support amidst several hardships. But, things turn bad in the family when Natraj gets married to a rich girl
programme.desc: விதவை சுந்தரியின் மூன்று மகன்களில் ஒருவரான நட்ராஜ் பணக்கார பெண்ணை மணக்கும்போது குடும்பத்தில் விஷயங்கள் மோசமாகிறது.

programme.title: நாதஸ்வரம்
programme.sub-title: Gopi, the owner of a tailor shop and son of Chokkalingam, a Nadaswaram player, goes about his daily life, with several ups and downs, along with his family
programme.desc: தையல்கடை உரிமையாளரும், நாதஸ்வரம் வாசிக்கும் சொக்கலிங்கத்தின் மகனுமான கோபி பல ஏற்ற தாழ்வுகளை குடும்பத்தோடு கடக்கிறார்.

credits.actor: Thirumurugan (Gopikrishnan Chokkalingam),T. S. B. K. Mouli (Chokkalingam),Poovilangu Mohan (Mayilvahanam),Srithika Saneesh (Malar),Jeyanthi Narayanan (Meenakshi Chokkalingam),Theni Sathyabama (Deyvanai Mayilvahanam)

programme.title: கோலங்கள்
programme.sub-title: Abhinaya, a hardworking woman, faces several hardships because of the people around her, including Adhitya, her stepbrother
programme.desc: கடின உழைப்பாளியான அபிநயா, தன்னைச் சுற்றியுள்ளவர்களால் பல கஷ்டங்களைச் சந்திக்கிறாள், அவளுடைய மாற்றாந்தாய் ஆதித்யா உட்பட.
