programme.title: ஆஸ்ஸி ஸ்னேக் வ்ராங்க்ளர்ஸ்
programme.sub-title: An aggravated eastern brown snake drive Mick and Adele nuts before the team are called to the biggest tree snake they've ever seen. For Stuart and Olivia, it's demolition time
programme.desc: ஆஸ்திரேலிய வீடுகளில் மறைந்திருக்கும் உலகின் கொடிய பாம்புகளை பிடிக்க முயலுகையில் ஆபத்துகளை எதிர்கொள்ளும் நிபுணர்கள்.

programme.title: லைஃப் ஆஃப் அ ப்ரெடேட்டர்
programme.desc: Track three apex predators, a golden eagle, an Iberian lynx and a red fox, as they navigate changing seasons and deploy unique hunting strategies to survive within their shared Mediterranean forest territory.

programme.title: சர்வைவிங் ஆஸ்திரேலியா
programme.sub-title: Survivors recount incidents of being lost in the Australian wilderness, getting stuck underground, being caught in landslides, and having close encounters with some of the country's deadliest inhabitants
programme.desc: ஆஸ்திரேலிய வனப்பகுதியிலிருந்து தப்பிப் பிழைத்தவர்களின் அனுபவங்களையும், அங்கு உயிர் பிழைக்கத் தேவையான நடைமுறை உத்திகளையும் இந்த ஆவணப்படம் விவரிக்கிறது.

programme.title: டெட்லியஸ்ட் சௌத் ஆஃப்ரிக்கா
programme.sub-title: Kurt Greenwood is on a quest to seek out South Africa's 12 most deadly snakes and to educate and inspire people to see the value of these often misunderstood creatures
programme.desc: தென்னாப்பிரிக்காவின் கொடிய பன்னிரண்டு பாம்புகளை தேடி, தவறாக அறியப்படும் அவற்றின் மதிப்பை கற்பிக்கும் குர்ட் கிரீன்வுட்.

programme.title: இத்தாலி : தி லாஸ்ட் வில்டர்னஸ் இயர் 1
programme.sub-title: Mediterranean beech woods are considered among the most beautiful and important on the continent
programme.desc: ஐரோப்பாவின் மையப்பகுதியில் உள்ள டானூப் நதிக்கரை காடுகளின் சுற்றுச்சூழல் அமைப்பில் செழித்து வளரும் வனவிலங்கு வாழ்விடம்.

programme.title: ப்ரதர்ஹூட் ஆஃப் லயன்ஸ்
programme.sub-title: The young males of the lion pride must form a coalition to work together against their rivals, but they first need to leave their mothers at two years old and fend for themselves
programme.desc: கென்யா மசாய் மாரா காட்டில் சிங்கங்களின் வாழ்க்கை, அவை எதிர்கொள்ளும் வேட்டையாடுதல் மற்றும் வாழ்விட இழப்பு பற்றி அறிக.

programme.title: ஆஸ்ஸி ஸ்னேக் வ்ராங்க்ளர்ஸ்
programme.sub-title: Chris and Stu come face-to-face with a giant red-bellied black snake that's taking shelter in a car's engine. In South Australia, Mick and Adele are helping local snake catcher, Dan, with one of his busiest snake catching seasons on record
programme.desc: ஆஸ்திரேலிய வீடுகளில் மறைந்திருக்கும் உலகின் கொடிய பாம்புகளை பிடிக்க முயலுகையில் ஆபத்துகளை எதிர்கொள்ளும் நிபுணர்கள்.

programme.title: ஆஸ்ஸி ஸ்னேக் வ்ராங்க்ளர்ஸ்
programme.sub-title: An aggravated eastern brown snake drive Mick and Adele nuts before the team are called to the biggest tree snake they've ever seen. For Stuart and Olivia, it's demolition time
programme.desc: ஆஸ்திரேலிய வீடுகளில் மறைந்திருக்கும் உலகின் கொடிய பாம்புகளை பிடிக்க முயலுகையில் ஆபத்துகளை எதிர்கொள்ளும் நிபுணர்கள்.

programme.title: த ஹிப்போ கிங்
programme.sub-title: The life story of a charismatic hippo in Zambia's Luangwa Valley. Over 35 years, he grows from a small calf to a full-fledged leader. His experiences make him stronger and stronger, until he is ready for kingship
programme.desc: பூமியில் தவறாக புரிந்து கொள்ளப்பட்ட மற்றும் புறக்கணிக்கப்பட்ட பாலூட்டியான நீர்யானையின் உண்மையான இயல்பு மற்றும் வாழ்க்கை.

programme.title: டெக்சாஸ் கேட்டர் சேவர்ஸ்
programme.sub-title: Gary searches for a gator in a disgusting drainage ditch while Arlie finds one hanging out in a crystal clear pool. Then, the Gator Country team hits the road for a show in Fort Worth
programme.desc: கேரி சௌரேஜ் குழுவினர், பல இடங்களிலிருந்து முதலைகளை மீட்டு, ஒரு புதிய சூழலில் அவை நலமாக வாழ்வதற்கு வழிவகை செய்கின்றனர்.

programme.title: த சவன்னா: வைல்ட் ஹேப்பினஸ்
programme.desc: The Savannah: Wild Happiness.

programme.title: ரிவர் மான்ஸ்டர்ஸ்
programme.sub-title: Jeremy Wade investigates a case in Nepal that sounds strangely familiar - a lone fisherman dragged off his feet and into a mountain river by the original river monster, the goonch catfish
programme.desc: நாட்டுப்புற கதைகள், புதிர்களை தகர்த்து நன்னீர் கண்டுபிடிப்பு இரகசியங்களை பற்றி உயிரியலாளர் ஜெர்மி வெட்ட வெளியிடுகிறார்.

credits.actor: Jeremy Wade,Vic Hislop,David Buckmeier,Mark Spitzer,Tim Mousseau,Daniel Göz

programme.title: நேச்சர்'ஸ் ஃபாஸ்ட் அட்டாக்ஸ்
programme.sub-title: Showcasing how the world's fastest predators can strike and kill in the blink of an eye, using modern high-speed cameras to capture these lightning-fast attacks in deadly detail
programme.desc: இயற்கையின் மிகப் பெரிய கொடிய மிருகங்களை ஆவணப்படுத்தும் இயக்குனர், அவற்றின் இரையைத் தாக்கும் முறைகளை விளக்குகிறார்.

programme.title: பாஸ்டியன் ஆஃப் த ஜெயண்ட்ஸ்
programme.sub-title: An engrossing journey into the lives of Asian Elephants, and the stunning bio-diverse North Eastern jungles of India around the river Brahmaputra
programme.desc: வடகிழக்கு இந்திய காடுகளில் ஆசிய யானைகளையும், மனிதருக்கும் விலங்குகளுக்கும் இணக்கமான எதிர்காலத்திற்கான முயற்சிகளும்.

programme.title: லோவென் கெகன் ஹ்யானென்
programme.sub-title: A year has passed since the lionesses of the Boulder Pride bore their cubs. The youngsters have got much bigger and, amazingly, all nine have survived. But the lions in the northern savannah on the border of Kenya and Tanzania have a problem
programme.desc: சிங்கங்கள் மற்றும் கழுதைப்புலிகளின் நடத்தையை ஆராய்ந்து, அவற்றின் போட்டியைப் பற்றிய முன்கூட்டிய கருத்துக்களை கூறுகிறது.

programme.title: ஸ்னோ லெப்பர்ட்ஸ் வித் டான் ஓ'நீல்
programme.sub-title: Navigating the harsh Mongolian wilderness with Dan O'Neill as he searches for 'The Dude', the largest snow leopard ever recorded
programme.desc: உயிரியலாளரும் இயற்கை ஆர்வலருமான டான் ஓ நீல், ஆராய்ச்சி மையத்தை உருவாக்கி பனிச்சிறுத்தையை பற்றி ஆய்வு செய்ய முயலுகிறார்.

programme.title: உல்வ்ஸ்: பவர் ஆஃப் த பேக்

programme.desc: ஆர்க்டிக் துந்திரா முதல் பரந்த சமவெளிகள் வரை, ஓநாய்களின் ஆதிக்கம் வட அரைக்கோளம் முழுவதும் பரவியுள்ள இந்த ஓநாய்கள் வனப்பகுதியின் அடையாளங்களாகவும், வாள்முனையில் வாழ்ந்து மடியும் அற்புதமான உயிரினங்களாகவும் திகழ்கின்றன.

programme.desc: Krugers Wild Kingdom.

programme.desc: Adventurer Sean Duggan heads to some of the most remote places on Earth in search of mysterious creatures - from land-prowling fish to giant predatory reptiles - in `Natural Born Monsters'. Duggan often enlists the help of local experts to locate and investigate the creatures and get the information he seeks.

programme.title: ப்ரதர்ஹூட் ஆஃப் லயன்ஸ்
programme.sub-title: The young males of the lion pride must form a coalition to work together against their rivals, but they first need to leave their mothers at two years old and fend for themselves

programme.title: Nuts About Squirrels
programme.desc: Some people love squirrels, others see them as pests and glorified rats, but we can all agree that the characterful rodents are speedy, quirky, exceptional climbers and go crazy for nuts.

programme.title: Super snakes
programme.desc: Snakes are a feature of nearly every culture in the world. 100,000 people die every year because of them. But we also owe our survival to snake predation on rodents. They attract a mythology which sometimes leaves the truth eating dust.

programme.title: ரேஸ் ஆஃப் லைஃப்
programme.sub-title: There are many fine examples of evolutionary history in the natural world. Animals adapt through a series of small, random mutations and usually do so in order to compete more effectively for food, water and space. Crocodiles are certainly of an ancient lineage, they are believed to be 200 million years old. Sharks have gone through the process of adaptation and evolutionary experimentation as well

programme.desc: சிங்கங்களுக்கும் ஹைனாக்களுக்கும் இடையிலான போட்டியையும், அவற்றின் மோதலையும்,சிக்கலான உறவையும் ஆராயும் இயக்குனர்.

programme.title: லைஃப் ஆஃப் அ ப்ரெடேட்டர்
programme.desc: Track three apex predators, a golden eagle, an Iberian lynx and a red fox, as they navigate changing seasons and deploy unique hunting strategies to survive within their shared Mediterranean forest territory.

programme.title: பிக் கேட் டேல்ஸ்
programme.sub-title: Chongo is unwilling to share buffalo with the rest of the pride and Fig continues to give vital lessons to the young cub and a cheetah and hyena battle
programme.desc: வேட்டையாட, துணையை தேட, இடங்களை காப்பாற்ற, குட்டிகளை வளர்க்க போராடும் பெரிய பூனைகளின் வெவ்வேறு இனங்களின் ஆவணம்.

programme.title: க்ரேட் பார்க்ஸ் ஆஃப் ஆஃப்ரிக்கா
programme.sub-title: In the centre of South Africa is an ancient landscape that was once an inland sea. Now it is a mosaic of unique habitats. Life here has evolved ingenious solutions to survive. There is nowhere in South Africa quite like the Karoo National Park
programme.desc: ஆப்பிரிக்காவின் இயற்கை சரணாலயங்கள், கண்டத்தின் அழகான மற்றும் பாதிக்கப்படக்கூடிய வனவிலங்கு பாரம்பரியத்தை பாதுகாக்கின்றன.

programme.title: வைல்ட் கஷ்மீர்
programme.desc: Wild Kashmir.

programme.title: ஷேர்ட் ஸ்பேஸ்
programme.desc: Shared Spaces.

programme.title: நேச்சுரல் பார்ன் மான்ஸ்டர்ஸ்
programme.sub-title: Sean scours the Yucatan Peninsula in search of the deadly jaguar that survived the same apocalypse that wiped out the Mayan civilisation
programme.desc: Adventurer Sean Duggan heads to some of the most remote places on Earth in search of mysterious creatures - from land-prowling fish to giant predatory reptiles - in `Natural Born Monsters'. When he unearths the creatures, he investigates how they have adapted to extreme weather conditions to survive in their often-dangerous environments and how weather has shaped the animals themselves. Duggan often enlists the help of local experts to locate and investigate the creatures and get the information he seeks.

programme.title: Jurassic Sharks
programme.desc: Prehistoric sharks rise from the dead as biologists investigate the superpredators that ruled the seas. Global expeditions yield new evidence of the strangest sharks to ever roam the ocean, and groundbreaking CGI technology brings them back to life.

programme.title: டெட்லியஸ்ட் சௌத் ஆஃப்ரிக்கா
programme.sub-title: Kurdt Greenwood is on a quest to seek out South Africa's 12 most deadly snakes and to educate and inspire people to see the value of these often misunderstood creatures
programme.desc: தென்னாப்பிரிக்காவின் கொடிய பன்னிரண்டு பாம்புகளை தேடி, தவறாக அறியப்படும் அவற்றின் மதிப்பை கற்பிக்கும் குர்ட் கிரீன்வுட்.

programme.title: ப்ரதர்ஹூட் ஆஃப் லயன்ஸ்
programme.sub-title: While the lion cubs at the Masai Mara Reserve prey on buffalo, one of them emerges to assert themselves as the dominant leader to guide the pride in attacking their victim
programme.desc: கென்யா மசாய் மாரா காட்டில் சிங்கங்களின் வாழ்க்கை, அவை எதிர்கொள்ளும் வேட்டையாடுதல் மற்றும் வாழ்விட இழப்பு பற்றி அறிக.

programme.title: அட்டன்பரோ'ஸ் லைஃப் இன் கலர்
programme.sub-title: In India, peacocks dazzle females with magnificent tail feathers; a tiny hummingbird in the deserts of North America unfurls his spectacular headdress as he dances for a mate; and in the darkness of a rainforest, powerful mandrill baboons signal their status with red and blue face masks, while tiny frogs warn of deadly poisons with brilliant colours
programme.desc: David Attenborough explores the vital role that colour plays in the daily life of various species. For us humans, it is a source of aesthetic beauty and expression, but for animals it is an essential tool used for survival and without it, there would be catastrophic consequences. Colours help animals to win a mate, to fight off rivals and to warn enemies. Attenborough explores nature's use of colour using technological advancements in camera equipment to reveal the world, as seen by animals.

programme.title: டைகர்ஃபிஷ்: ஆஃப்ரிக்கா'ஸ் பிரான்னா
programme.sub-title: Tigerfish are terrifying freshwater predators. Extreme angler Andy Coetzee undertakes a hazardous journey to study the giant-sized species in their habitat in the Congo
programme.desc: மீன் இனமான டைகர்ஃபிஷின் நடத்தையை ஆய்வு செய்வதற்காக ஒரு பாதுகாவலர் ஆப்பிரிக்காவின் ஆறுகள் வழியாக பயணம் செய்கிறார்.

programme.title: ஆஸ்ஸி ஸ்னேக் வ்ராங்க்ளர்ஸ்
programme.sub-title: Chris and Stu come face-to-face with a giant red-bellied black snake that's taking shelter in a car's engine. In South Australia, Mick and Adele are helping local snake catcher, Dan, with one of his busiest snake catching seasons on record
programme.desc: ஆஸ்திரேலிய வீடுகளில் மறைந்திருக்கும் உலகின் கொடிய பாம்புகளை பிடிக்க முயலுகையில் ஆபத்துகளை எதிர்கொள்ளும் நிபுணர்கள்.

programme.title: ஆஸ்ஸி ஸ்னேக் வ்ராங்க்ளர்ஸ்
programme.sub-title: An aggravated eastern brown snake drive Mick and Adele nuts before the team are called to the biggest tree snake they've ever seen. For Stuart and Olivia, it's demolition time
programme.desc: ஆஸ்திரேலிய வீடுகளில் மறைந்திருக்கும் உலகின் கொடிய பாம்புகளை பிடிக்க முயலுகையில் ஆபத்துகளை எதிர்கொள்ளும் நிபுணர்கள்.

programme.title: శివ
programme.sub-title: Shiva is a brave and intelligent child who stays with his grandparents in Vedas City. He sets out with his gang of friends to save the citizens from all sorts of evil
programme.desc: వేదాస్ నగరంలో తన బామ్మాతాతాలతో నివసించే ధైర్యంగల శివ, మిత్రులతో కలిసి తన నగరాన్ని దుష్ట శక్తుల నుండి కాపాడాలనుకుంటాడు.

credits.actor: Nilufer Middey,Sonal Kaushal,Rupa Bhimani,Anamay Verma,Aditya Jaiswal,Brij Bhushan Sawhney,Manoj Pandey

programme.title: పాక్ పకావు
programme.sub-title: Follow the whimsical and absurd conversations of two friends and learn new things as they navigate life's everyday mysteries
programme.desc: ఇద్దరు స్నేహితుల విచిత్రమైన, మరియు అసంబద్ధమైన సంభాషణలను అనుసరించండి మరియు వారు జీవితంలోని కొత్త విషయాలను నేర్చుకోండి.

programme.title: పకడమ్ పకడై - ధమాకేదార్ ఇన్‌వెన్షన్స్
programme.sub-title: Bringing the best in cinema
programme.desc: సినిమా రంగంలోని అత్యుత్తమమైన సినిమాలను కొన్నింటిని అందిస్తారు.

programme.title: Zig Aur Marina Bff
programme.desc: Zig, a hyena, tries to attack Marina, a mermaid, but her friend Sharko stops him. Set in France, the trio's adventures unfold with humor everyday.

programme.title: పినాకి అండ్ హ్యాపీ
programme.sub-title: The ghost family faces a direct head-to-head collision with humans as the supernatural world is turned upside down. Pinaki and Happy must navigate a wave of chaotic spirit pranks to restore balance and keep their household secrets perfectly safe
programme.desc: Happy and Pinaki live with their ghost family in Vibhooti Mansion. They embark on spooky adventures, uncover scary secrets, and discover courage, friendship, and bravery together.

programme.title: పినాకి అండ్ హ్యాపీ ఇన్ ది డార్క్ అవర్
programme.sub-title: Happy and Pinaki live with a ghost family in Vibhooti Mansion, and they face eerie adventures while uncovering hidden frightening secrets about their home and themselves
programme.desc: డార్క్ అవర్ సమయంలో,పినాకి,హ్యాపీ కాలంతో పోటీ పడుతూ, చందూల కిరీటాన్ని దొంగిలించి భూత ప్రపంచాన్ని ఆపడానికి ప్రయత్నిస్తారు.

programme.title: డోరేమాన్: నోబితా అండ్ గెలాక్సీ సూపర్-ఎక్స్‌ప్రెస్
programme.sub-title: Nobita and his friends along with Doraemon go on a mystery trip through the cosmos on the Galaxy Super-express train. But trouble awaits them as soon as they reach the destination
programme.desc: గెలాక్సీ సూపర్-ఎక్స్‌ప్రెస్ రైలులో రహస్య యాత్రకు వెళ్లిన నోబితా, అతని మిత్రులు గమ్యం చేరుకునేలోపు అనేక కష్టాలు ఎదుర్కొంటారు.

credits.actor: Nobuyo Oyama (Doraemon),Noriko Ohara (Nobita Nobi),Michiko Nomura (Shizuka Minamoto),Kaneta Kiomtsuki (Suneo Honekawa),Kazuya Tatekabe (Takesi Goda),Mitsuaki Madono (Aston)

programme.title: జిగ్ అండ్ షార్కో
programme.sub-title: Zig the hyena lives all alone on a desert island and schemes to eat Marina
programme.desc: జిగ్ అనే హైనా, మెరీనా అనే మత్స్యకన్యను తినడానికి ప్రయత్నిస్తుంది, కానీ ఆమె మిత్రుడు షార్కో ఆమెని జిగ్ నుండి కాపాడతాడు.

credits.director: Olivier Jean-Marie,Andrés Fernández,Cédric Dietsch,Khalil Ben Naamane,Yani Ouabdesselam,Nicolas Bougard,Pierre-Gilles Stehr

programme.title: పినాకి అండ్ హ్యాపీ -ది భూత్ బంధుస్
programme.sub-title: Pinaki and his family of ghosts embark on spooky adventures and a series of fun and slapstick comedy as they try to fit in the outside world
programme.desc: పినాకి, అతని దెయ్యాల కుటుంబం బయటి ప్రపంచంలో ఇమిడిపోవడానికి ప్రయత్నిస్తూ, భయానక సాహసాలు, హాస్య సంఘటనల పరంపరలో పయనిస్తారు.

credits.actor: Sonal Kaushal,Rajesh Kava,Manoj Pandey,Aranya Kaur,Pawan Kalra,Meghna Erande,Bhakti Jhaveri,Pooja Punjabi

programme.title: పాక్ పకావు
programme.sub-title: Follow the whimsical and absurd conversations of two friends and learn new things as they navigate life's everyday mysteries
programme.desc: ఇద్దరు స్నేహితుల విచిత్రమైన, మరియు అసంబద్ధమైన సంభాషణలను అనుసరించండి మరియు వారు జీవితంలోని కొత్త విషయాలను నేర్చుకోండి.

programme.title: పకడమ్ పకడై - ధమాకేదార్ ఇన్‌వెన్షన్స్
programme.sub-title: Bringing the best in cinema
programme.desc: సినిమా రంగంలోని అత్యుత్తమమైన సినిమాలను కొన్నింటిని అందిస్తారు.

programme.title: జిగ్ అండ్ బెర్నీ
programme.sub-title: Accompanied by his best friend Bernie, a hermit crab, Zig, a hyena, embarks on a series of schemes to capture Marina, a mermaid. But his plans are thwarted by a cunning shark
programme.desc: మత్యకన్య మెరీనాను పట్టుకోడానికి తన ప్రాణమిత్రుడైన బెర్నీతో కలిసి జిగ్ అనే హైనా చేసే కుట్రలను ఒక షార్క్ అడ్డుకుంటుంది.

programme.title: పినాకి అండ్ హ్యాపీ
programme.sub-title: The ghost family faces a direct head-to-head collision with humans as the supernatural world is turned upside down. Pinaki and Happy must navigate a wave of chaotic spirit pranks to restore balance and keep their household secrets perfectly safe
programme.desc: Happy and Pinaki live with their ghost family in Vibhooti Mansion. They embark on spooky adventures, uncover scary secrets, and discover courage, friendship, and bravery together.

programme.title: భూత్ బంధుస్ ఇన్ సూపర్ ఘోస్ట్ కార్నివాల్‌
programme.sub-title: Chaos breaks out when the family of ghosts led by Colonel Suri takes part in the Super Ghost Carnival and meets a veteran's spirit that poses as an enemy
programme.desc: కల్నల్ సూరి దెయ్యాల కుటుంబం సూపర్ ఘోస్ట్ కార్నివాల్‌లో పాల్గొని, ఒక మాజీ సైనికుడి ఆత్మను కలవడంతో గందరగోళం చెలరేగుతుంది.

programme.title: డోరేమాన్ మూవీ: తూఫాని అడ్వెంచర్
programme.sub-title: After an old wizard is freed from a mysterious tomb, Doraemon, a robotic cat, and Nobita Nobi, a pre-teen boy, go to the Wind Village to prevent any mishaps there
programme.desc: రోబో పిల్లి డోరేమాన్, నోబితా నోబి అనే బాలుడు సమాధి నుండి విముక్తి పొందిన మాంత్రికుడి నుండి విండ్ గ్రామాన్ని కాపాడతారు.

credits.actor: Nobuyo Ohyama (Doraemon),Noriko Ohara (Nobita Nobi; Michiko Nomura: Shizuka Minamoto;),Michiko Nomura (Shizuka Minamoto;),Kaneta Kimotsuki (Suneo Honegawa),Kazuya Tatekabe (Takeshi Gouda),Mika Kanai (Fukko)

programme.title: జిగ్ అండ్ షార్కో
programme.sub-title: Zig the hyena lives all alone on a desert island and schemes to eat Marina
programme.desc: జిగ్ అనే హైనా, మెరీనా అనే మత్స్యకన్యను తినడానికి ప్రయత్నిస్తుంది, కానీ ఆమె మిత్రుడు షార్కో ఆమెని జిగ్ నుండి కాపాడతాడు.

credits.director: Olivier Jean-Marie,Andrés Fernández,Cédric Dietsch,Khalil Ben Naamane,Yani Ouabdesselam,Nicolas Bougard,Pierre-Gilles Stehr

programme.title: పినాకి అండ్ హ్యాపీ -ది భూత్ బంధుస్
programme.sub-title: Pinaki and his family of ghosts embark on spooky adventures and a series of fun and slapstick comedy as they try to fit in the outside world
programme.desc: పినాకి, అతని దెయ్యాల కుటుంబం బయటి ప్రపంచంలో ఇమిడిపోవడానికి ప్రయత్నిస్తూ, భయానక సాహసాలు, హాస్య సంఘటనల పరంపరలో పయనిస్తారు.

credits.actor: Sonal Kaushal,Rajesh Kava,Manoj Pandey,Aranya Kaur,Pawan Kalra,Meghna Erande,Bhakti Jhaveri,Pooja Punjabi

programme.desc: அமெச்சூர் கிரிக்கெட் அணிகள், ஏசி‌சி 19-வயதிற்குட்பட்டோருக்கான ஆசியக் கோப்பையை வென்று அந்த மதிப்புமிக்க பட்டத்தைக் கைப்பற்ற ஒன்றோடொன்று போட்டியிடுகின்றன.

programme.title: ஒன்-டே இன்டர்நேஷனல் க்ரிக்கெட்
programme.sub-title: An extensive and thorough coverage of one-day cricket matches contested by various international teams from across the globe
programme.desc: உலகெங்கிலுமுள்ள பல்வேறு சர்வதேச அணிகள் போட்டியிடும் ஒரு நாள் கிரிக்கெட் போட்டிகளின் விரிவான மற்றும் முழுமையான தகவல்கள்.

programme.sub-title: Hindu religious scholars and a group of devotees of Lord Venkateswara gather and sing sacred songs while worshipping and revering the deity
programme.desc: இந்து சமய அறிஞர்களும் வெங்கடேசப் பெருமானின் பக்தர் குழுவினரும் ஒன்றுகூடி, அத்தெய்வத்தை வழிபட்டுப் போற்றியவாறே புனிதப் பாடல்களைப் பாடுகின்றனர்.

programme.sub-title: A spiritual leader delivers a detailed discourse to devotees on the life of Lord Ganesha and the teachings imparted by sacred texts
programme.desc: விநாயக பெருமானின் வாழ்க்கை வரலாறு குறித்தும், புனித நூல்கள் உணர்த்தும் ஆன்மீகப் போதனைகள் குறித்தும் ஒரு மத தலைவர் பக்தர்களுக்கு விரிவான சொற்பொழிவை வழங்குகிறார்.

programme.sub-title: Devotees sing a melodious rendition of 'Sri Venkateswara Suprabhatam', a hymn recited every morning at the Tirumala hill shrine, as a wake-up call for Lord Venkateswara, live

programme.title: స్మాషింగ్ సింబా
programme.sub-title: Simmba, an honest and courageous police officer, teams up with his fearless colleagues in his mission to confront and defeat the evil forces of society
programme.desc: నిజాయితీగల, ధైర్యవంతుడైన పోలీసు అధికారి సింబా, తన సహచరులతో కలిసి సమాజంలోని దుష్ట శక్తులను ఎదుర్కొవాలనుకుంటాడు.

programme.title: ఛోటా భీమ్
programme.sub-title: Bheem is an extremely brave, strong and intelligent young boy. He often manages to solve everyone's problems which endears him to the townspeople of Dholakpur
programme.desc: చాలా ధైర్యవంతుడు, బలమైన, తెలివైన బాలుడు భీమ్, ఢోలక్‌పూర్‌ పట్టణవాసుల సమస్యలన్నింటినీ పరిష్కరించగలుగుతాడు.

credits.actor: Vatsal Dubey (Chhota Bheem),Julie Tejwani (Raju),Rupa Bhimani (Chutki),Sabina Malik Mausam (Kalia),Rajesh Kava (Jaggu),Prince Patel (Takiya)

programme.title: లిటిల్ సింగం
programme.sub-title: Little Singham, an honest but ferocious police officer, fights against injustice and defends his town from formidable enemies

programme.sub-title: The Kaalverse threatens the Singhamverse in an imminent conflict. Meanwhile, a fresh guardian must rise to defend the nation and secure a fading legacy

programme.title: గ్రిజ్జీ అండ్ ద లెమ్మింగ్స్
programme.sub-title: Grizzy, a bear, lives in the forest ranger's house every time he leaves and considers it as his own. However, things change when a tribe of lemmings moves into the same house

credits.director: Victor Moulin,Cédric Lachenaud,Alexandre Wahl,Corentin Lecourt,Clément Girard,Idriss Benseghir,Célestine Jacquel-Plays

programme.title: ఛోటా భీమ్
programme.sub-title: Bheem is an extremely brave, strong and intelligent young boy. He often manages to solve everyone's problems which endears him to the townspeople of Dholakpur
programme.desc: చాలా ధైర్యవంతుడు, బలమైన, తెలివైన బాలుడు భీమ్, ఢోలక్‌పూర్‌ పట్టణవాసుల సమస్యలన్నింటినీ పరిష్కరించగలుగుతాడు.

credits.actor: Vatsal Dubey (Chhota Bheem),Julie Tejwani (Raju),Rupa Bhimani (Chutki),Sabina Malik Mausam (Kalia),Rajesh Kava (Jaggu),Prince Patel (Takiya)

programme.title: ఛోటా భీమ్-భీమయన్
programme.sub-title: Chhota Bheem and his friends put on a stage show of the Ramayana on the auspicious occasion of Diwali and re-enact the epic tale behind the festival of lights
programme.desc: దీపావళి పండుగ శుభ సందర్భంగా ఛోటా భీమ్, అతని స్నేహితులు వేదికపై రామాయణ ఇతిహాస గాథను తిరిగి ప్రదర్శిస్తారు.

programme.title: ఛోటా భీమ్: లెజెండ్ ఆఫ్ ది జెయింట్స్
programme.sub-title: As Garajasur threatens the village's protective ritual against demons, Bheem and mystical guardians unite to safeguard everyone
programme.desc: గరజాసురుడి చక్రవీర శక్తులను సొంతం చేసుకోవాలనుకునే మహా శైతాన్ బారి నుండి తన గ్రామాన్ని కాపాడడానికి భీమ్, మహా భీమ్‌గా మారతాడు.

programme.title: లిటిల్ సింగం శక్తి వాన్ కా సికిందర్
programme.sub-title: Little Singham bravely faces various challenges and confronts evil forces that are intent on wreaking havoc on a forest
programme.desc: లిటిల్ సింగం ధైర్యంగా వివిధ సవాళ్లను, అడవిని నాశనం చేయాలనే ఉద్దేశ్యంతో ఉన్న దుష్ట శక్తులను ఎదుర్కొంటాడు.

programme.title: గ్రిజ్జీ అండ్ ద లెమ్మింగ్స్
programme.sub-title: Grizzy, a bear, lives in the forest ranger's house every time he leaves and considers it as his own. However, things change when a tribe of lemmings moves into the same house
programme.desc: గ్రిజ్జీ అనే ఎలుగుబంటి ఒక అటవీ రేంజర్ ఇంటిని తన సొంత నివాసంగా భావిస్తుంది, అయితే లెమ్మింగ్స్ రాకతో పరిస్థితి మారుతుంది.

credits.director: Victor Moulin,Cédric Lachenaud,Alexandre Wahl,Corentin Lecourt,Clément Girard,Idriss Benseghir,Célestine Jacquel-Plays

programme.sub-title: Follow the hilarious misadventures of Sampat and Champat, two bumbling thieves who constantly hatch chaotic plans that backfire, landing them in endless trouble with the local police

programme.title: ఛోటా భీమ్

programme.title: లిటిల్ సింగం
programme.sub-title: Little Singham, an honest but ferocious police officer, fights against injustice and defends his town from formidable enemies
programme.desc: నిజాయితీపరుడైన పోలీసు అధికారి లిటిల్ సింగం అన్యాయానికి వ్యతిరేకంగా పోరాడుతూ, శత్రువుల నుండి తన పట్టణాన్ని కాపాడతాడు.

credits.actor: Swapnil Kumari,Jigna Bharadhwaj,Sonal Kaushal,Neshma Chemburkar,Ganessh Divekar,Shaily Dubey,Saumya Daan,Anamaya Verma,Sumrridhi Shukla

programme.title: లెస్ లియో రైస్ ఆఫ్ సూపర్ సింగం
programme.sub-title: Little Singham, a young but ferocious policeman and his friends set out on an adventure with their friends in order to fight the evil forces
programme.desc: ధైర్యవంతుడైన పోలీసు అధికారి లిటిల్ సింగం, అతడి స్నేహితులు కలిసి దుష్ట శక్తులతో పోరాడుతూ, అనేక సాహసాలు చేస్తారు.

programme.title: ఆర్ఆర్ఆర్5 లిటిల్ సింగం అండ్ ఛోటా భీమ్ సూర్యవంశీ యోధ
programme.sub-title: Chhota Bheem and Little Singham join forces to defeat the rising evil with their tactics and bring back happiness to their lands
programme.desc: ఛోటా భీమ్, లిటిల్ సింగం కలిసి తమ వ్యూహాలతో పెరుగుతున్న చెడుని అంతం చేసి, భూమిపై ఆనందం తీసుకురావడానికి ప్రయత్నిస్తారు.

programme.title: ఛోటా భీమ్ ఔర్ లిటిల్ సింగం - ఐస్ ఏజ్ కా ఆతంక్
programme.sub-title: Chhota Bheem and Little Singham join forces as they embark on a new mission on frozen islands to fight against the mighty icy monsters
programme.desc: ఛోటా భీమ్, లిటిల్ సింగం కలిసి ఘనీభవించిన దీవులలో శక్తివంతమైన మంచు రాక్షసులతో పోరాడటానికి ఒక మిషన్‌ను ప్రారంభిస్తారు.

programme.title: లిటిల్ సింగం అండ్ ఛోటా భీమ్ రైజ్ ఆఫ్ బేతాళ్
programme.sub-title: When a forgotten demon returns from legend, two young heroes team up to protect their world using courage, cleverness and unexpected teamwork
programme.desc: విస్మరించబడిన ఒక రాక్షసుడు తిరిగి వచ్చినప్పుడు, ఇద్దరు యువ వీరులు తమ ప్రపంచాన్ని రక్షించుకోవడానికి ఏకమవుతారు.

programme.title: మల్టీవర్స్ మే దోబారా
programme.sub-title: Little Singham and his friends journey across the multiverse, enduring perils and striving to keep the nefarious forces of evil at bay
programme.desc: లిటిల్ సింగం, అతని స్నేహితులు ప్రజలలో శాంతిని నెలకొల్పి, న్యాయాన్ని కాపాడడానికి దుష్టశక్తులతో పోరాడతారు.

programme.title: గ్రిజ్జీ అండ్ ద లెమ్మింగ్స్
programme.sub-title: Grizzy, a bear, lives in the forest ranger's house every time he leaves and considers it as his own. However, things change when a tribe of lemmings moves into the same house
programme.desc: గ్రిజ్జీ అనే ఎలుగుబంటి ఒక అటవీ రేంజర్ ఇంటిని తన సొంత నివాసంగా భావిస్తుంది, అయితే లెమ్మింగ్స్ రాకతో పరిస్థితి మారుతుంది.

credits.director: Victor Moulin,Cédric Lachenaud,Alexandre Wahl,Corentin Lecourt,Clément Girard,Idriss Benseghir,Célestine Jacquel-Plays

programme.desc: గ్రిజ్జీ అనే ఎలుగుబంటి ఒక అటవీ రేంజర్ ఇంటిని తన సొంత నివాసంగా భావిస్తుంది, అయితే లెమ్మింగ్స్ రాకతో పరిస్థితి మారుతుంది.

credits.director: Victor Moulin,Cédric Lachenaud,Alexandre Wahl,Corentin Lecourt,Clément Girard,Idriss Benseghir,Célestine Jacquel-Plays

programme.title: సంపత్ చంపత్
programme.sub-title: Follow the hilarious misadventures of Sampat and Champat, two bumbling thieves who constantly hatch chaotic plans that backfire, landing them in endless trouble with the local police
programme.desc: సంపత్, చంపత్ అనే ఇద్దరు చేతకాని దొంగలు నిరంతరం స్థానిక పోలీసుల చిక్కుల్లో పడే హాస్యభరితమైన సాహసాలను అనుసరించండి.

programme.title: మైటీ లిటిల్ భీమ్
programme.sub-title: Bheem, an affectionate toddler, has many adventures with his little friends and loving family. Every day he learns something new as he grows taller
programme.desc: తన స్నేహితులు, ప్రేమగల కుటుంబంతో కలిసి అనేక సాహసాలు చేసే పసిబిడ్డ భీమ్, పెరిగే కొద్దీ ఏదో ఒక కొత్త విషయం నేర్చుకుంటాడు.

programme.title: ఛోటా భీమ్ ఔర్ గణేష్ ఇన్ ది అమేజింగ్ ఒడిస్సీ
programme.sub-title: Chhota Bheem, along with Lord Ganesha, uses his supernatural powers to save Dholakpur from evil forces and the citizens from jeopardy
programme.desc: దుష్ట శక్తుల నుండి ఢోలక్‌పూర్‌ని, దాని ప్రజలను కాపాడటానికి భగవాన్ గణేశతో కలిసి ఛోటా భీమ్ తన శక్తులను ఉపయోగిస్తాడు.

programme.title: ఛోటా భీమ్
programme.sub-title: Bheem is an extremely brave, strong and intelligent young boy. He often manages to solve everyone's problems which endears him to the townspeople of Dholakpur
programme.desc: చాలా ధైర్యవంతుడు, బలమైన, తెలివైన బాలుడు భీమ్, ఢోలక్‌పూర్‌ పట్టణవాసుల సమస్యలన్నింటినీ పరిష్కరించగలుగుతాడు.

credits.actor: Vatsal Dubey (Chhota Bheem),Julie Tejwani (Raju),Rupa Bhimani (Chutki),Sabina Malik Mausam (Kalia),Rajesh Kava (Jaggu),Prince Patel (Takiya)

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Dan Short fell in love with cars when he first laid eyes on a 1967 Camaro. He bought a used model as a teenager, but because he couldn't pay someone else to restore it, he learned how to do the work himself. After a stint in the Army, Short decided to make his passion for classic cars his life's work, and FantomWorks was born. Today the Norfolk, Va., company is the largest auto restoration shop in the U.S., and this reality series shows how Short and his team meticulously refurbish some of America's favorite rides. Drama ensues in the form of personality clashes, cost overruns, irate customers and other issues, which are compounded by Short's reputation as a straight shooter who won't accept substandard results.

programme.desc: The FBI suspects' fraudulent business practices are linked to the mysterious disappearance of Candor Diamond Corporation president, Irwin Margolies. Weeks after Margolies turns up, and begins cooperating with authorities, several Candor employees are now the victims of brutal murders. programme.title: Monsters and Mysteries
programme.desc: Whether the protagonist is a Batsquatch, Skunk Ape, Mothman or Chupacabra, tales of mysterious creatures and unexplainable phenomena have been passed down generations. \"Monsters and Mysteries in America\" takes a trip across the U.S. to reveal the most cryptic, frightening and brow-furrowing stories. Each hourlong episode focuses on a specific region and the lore of residents who claim to have encountered legendary monsters, ancient spirits or alien beings. With America's dense forests, desert grasslands, and hundreds of miles of uninhabitable wilderness, could it really house -- or hide -- so many mysterious creatures?

programme.title: जंगल बुक
programme.sub-title: Mowgli, a young boy, is raised in the jungle by wolves. He has two loyal friends, Bagheera, a panther, and Baloo, a bear, who safeguard him from Shere Khan, a Bengal tiger, who wants to devour Mowgli
programme.desc: एक छोटा लड़का मोगली, जंगल में भेड़ियों के बीच पला-बढ़ा है। उसके दो वफादार दोस्त हैं, बघीरा (एक तेंदुआ), और बल्लू (एक भालू), जो उसे शेर खान (एक बंगाल टाइगर) से बचाते हैं, जो मोगली को खाना चाहता है।.

programme.sub-title: Bringing the best in television
programme.desc: टेलीविजन के सर्वश्रेष्ठ कार्यक्रमों की प्रस्तुति।.

programme.title: 12 ज्योतिर्लिंग दर्शन
programme.sub-title: Devotees come together to participate in a pilgrimage to visit the 12 Jyotirlingas, which are considered a divine manifestation of Lord Shiva
programme.desc: भक्तगण 12 ज्योतिर्लिंगों के दर्शन हेतु तीर्थयात्रा में भाग लेने के लिए एकत्रित होते हैं, जिन्हें भगवान शिव का दिव्य स्वरूप माना जाता है।.

programme.title: धर्म कथा
programme.sub-title: A religious leader sheds light on the teachings of the Almighty and encourages followers to take the path of spirituality
programme.desc: एक धार्मिक पथप्रदर्शक, ईश्वर की शिक्षाओं पर प्रकाश डालते हैं और अनुयायियों को आध्यात्मिकता का मार्ग अपनाने के लिए प्रोत्साहित करते हैं।.

programme.title: भक्ति प्रवाह
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of ancient hymns and spiritual verses chanted in order to praise the Almighty is played back to back
programme.desc: यह कार्यक्रम, परमेश्वर की स्तुति के लिए संगीतबद्ध किए गए प्राचीन भजनों और आध्यात्मिक छंदों का व्यापक संकलन प्रस्तुत किया जाता है।.

programme.title: भूत बॉस (पाप-ओ-मीटर)
programme.sub-title: Bhoot Boss, Thakela and Pakela are ghosts who seek out people that have sinned and teach them a lesson to reduce wrongdoings in the world. However, their mission lands them in precarious situations
programme.desc: भूत बॉस, थकेला और पकेला भूत हैं जो पाप करने वाले लोगों को ढूंढ उन्हें सबक सिखाते हैं। हालांकि, उनका मिशन उन्हें अनिश्चित परिस्थितियों में डाल देता है।.

programme.title: जानबाज़ मुर्गा
programme.sub-title: A fun-loving chicken along with his friends embark on various adventures, as they overcome challenges and share heartfelt moments
programme.desc: एक मौज-मस्ती पसंद करने वाला मुर्गा अपने दोस्तों के साथ विभिन्न साहसिक कार्यों पर निकलता है, जहां वे चुनौतियों पर विजय प्राप्त करते हैं और दिल को छू लेने वाले पल साझा करते हैं।.

programme.title: जीजा जी छत पर है
programme.sub-title: Elaichi's mischievous antics keep her father Murari on edge, while Pancham, secretly in love with her, navigates hilarious mishaps due to his hidden marital status
programme.desc: इलायची की शरारतें उसके पिता मुरारी को परेशान रखती हैं, जबकि पंचम, जो मन ही मन इलायची से प्यार करता है, अपनी छुपी हुई वैवाहिक स्थिति के कारण हास्यास्पद घटनाओं से गुजरता है।.

credits.actor: Hiba Nawab,Nikhil Khurana,Anup Upadhyay,Soma Rathod,Harveer Singh,Raashi Bawa,Firoz Khan,Naveen Bawa,Saheb Das Manikpuri

programme.title: मद्दाम सर
programme.sub-title: Four brave female police officers of Aminabad police station use their wittiness and emotional intelligence to tackle the various challenges they face at their work
programme.desc: अमीनाबाद पुलिस स्टेशन की चार बहादुर महिला पुलिस अधिकारी अपने कार्यस्थल की विभिन्न चुनौतियों से निपटने के लिए अपनी बुद्धिमता और भावनात्मक बुद्धिमत्ता का उपयोग करती हैं।.

programme.desc: टेलीविजन के सर्वश्रेष्ठ कार्यक्रमों की प्रस्तुति।.

programme.title: जंगल बुक
programme.sub-title: Mowgli, a young boy, is raised in the jungle by wolves. He has two loyal friends, Bagheera, a panther, and Baloo, a bear, who safeguard him from Shere Khan, a Bengal tiger, who wants to devour Mowgli
programme.desc: एक छोटा लड़का मोगली, जंगल में भेड़ियों के बीच पला-बढ़ा है। उसके दो वफादार दोस्त हैं, बघीरा (एक तेंदुआ), और बल्लू (एक भालू), जो उसे शेर खान (एक बंगाल टाइगर) से बचाते हैं, जो मोगली को खाना चाहता है।.

programme.title: बब्लू डबलू
programme.sub-title: An evil logger decides to turn the forest into his personal lumberyard. However, things change after Bablu and Dablu, two bear brothers, decide to stop him
programme.desc: एक दुष्ट लकड़हारा जंगल को अपना निजी लकड़हारा बनाने का फ़ैसला करता है। लेकिन, दो भालू भाइयों, बबलू और डबलू, द्वारा उसे रोकने के फ़ैसले के बाद चीज़ें बदल जाती हैं।.

programme.title: हनी बनी
programme.sub-title: Bringing the best in television
programme.desc: टेलीविजन के सर्वश्रेष्ठ कार्यक्रमों की प्रस्तुति।.

programme.title: 12 ज्योतिर्लिंग दर्शन
programme.sub-title: Devotees come together to participate in a pilgrimage to visit the 12 Jyotirlingas, which are considered a divine manifestation of Lord Shiva
programme.desc: भक्तगण 12 ज्योतिर्लिंगों के दर्शन हेतु तीर्थयात्रा में भाग लेने के लिए एकत्रित होते हैं, जिन्हें भगवान शिव का दिव्य स्वरूप माना जाता है।.

programme.title: धर्म कथा
programme.sub-title: A religious leader sheds light on the teachings of the Almighty and encourages followers to take the path of spirituality
programme.desc: एक धार्मिक पथप्रदर्शक, ईश्वर की शिक्षाओं पर प्रकाश डालते हैं और अनुयायियों को आध्यात्मिकता का मार्ग अपनाने के लिए प्रोत्साहित करते हैं।.

programme.title: भक्ति प्रवाह
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of ancient hymns and spiritual verses chanted in order to praise the Almighty is played back to back
programme.desc: यह कार्यक्रम, परमेश्वर की स्तुति के लिए संगीतबद्ध किए गए प्राचीन भजनों और आध्यात्मिक छंदों का व्यापक संकलन प्रस्तुत किया जाता है।.

programme.title: भूत बॉस (पाप-ओ-मीटर)
programme.sub-title: Bhoot Boss, Thakela and Pakela are ghosts who seek out people that have sinned and teach them a lesson to reduce wrongdoings in the world. However, their mission lands them in precarious situations
programme.desc: भूत बॉस, थकेला और पकेला भूत हैं जो पाप करने वाले लोगों को ढूंढ उन्हें सबक सिखाते हैं। हालांकि, उनका मिशन उन्हें अनिश्चित परिस्थितियों में डाल देता है।.

programme.title: जानबाज़ मुर्गा
programme.sub-title: A fun-loving chicken along with his friends embark on various adventures, as they overcome challenges and share heartfelt moments
programme.desc: एक मौज-मस्ती पसंद करने वाला मुर्गा अपने दोस्तों के साथ विभिन्न साहसिक कार्यों पर निकलता है, जहां वे चुनौतियों पर विजय प्राप्त करते हैं और दिल को छू लेने वाले पल साझा करते हैं।.

programme.title: यस बॉस
programme.sub-title: Bringing the best in television
programme.desc: टेलीविजन के सर्वश्रेष्ठ कार्येक्रम।.

programme.title: जीजा जी छत पर है
programme.sub-title: Elaichi's mischievous antics keep her father Murari on edge, while Pancham, secretly in love with her, navigates hilarious mishaps due to his hidden marital status
programme.desc: इलायची की शरारतें उसके पिता मुरारी को परेशान रखती हैं, जबकि पंचम, जो मन ही मन इलायची से प्यार करता है, अपनी छुपी हुई वैवाहिक स्थिति के कारण हास्यास्पद घटनाओं से गुजरता है।.

credits.actor: Hiba Nawab,Nikhil Khurana,Anup Upadhyay,Soma Rathod,Harveer Singh,Raashi Bawa,Firoz Khan,Naveen Bawa,Saheb Das Manikpuri

programme.title: मद्दाम सर
programme.sub-title: Four brave female police officers of Aminabad police station use their wittiness and emotional intelligence to tackle the various challenges they face at their work
programme.desc: अमीनाबाद पुलिस स्टेशन की चार बहादुर महिला पुलिस अधिकारी अपने कार्यस्थल की विभिन्न चुनौतियों से निपटने के लिए अपनी बुद्धिमता और भावनात्मक बुद्धिमत्ता का उपयोग करती हैं।.

credits.actor: Bhavika Sharma (Santosh \"Santu\" Sharma),Gulki Joshi (Haseena Mallik),Sonali Pandit Naik (Pushpa Singh),Yukti Kapoor (Karishma Singh),Rahil Azam (Anubhav Singh),Ajay Jadhav (Billu Champat),Yashkant Sharma (Cheteshwar \"Cheetah\" Chaturvedi),Priyanshu Singh (Cheteshwar \"Cheetah\" Chaturvedi)

programme.desc: अमीनाबाद पुलिस स्टेशन की चार बहादुर महिला पुलिस अधिकारी अपने कार्यस्थल की विभिन्न चुनौतियों से निपटने के लिए अपनी बुद्धिमता और भावनात्मक बुद्धिमत्ता का उपयोग करती हैं।.

credits.actor: Bhavika Sharma (Santosh \"Santu\" Sharma),Gulki Joshi (Haseena Mallik),Sonali Pandit Naik (Pushpa Singh),Yukti Kapoor (Karishma Singh),Rahil Azam (Anubhav Singh),Ajay Jadhav (Billu Champat),Yashkant Sharma (Cheteshwar \"Cheetah\" Chaturvedi),Priyanshu Singh (Cheteshwar \"Cheetah\" Chaturvedi)

programme.title: हनी बनी
programme.sub-title: Bringing the best in television
programme.desc: टेलीविजन के सर्वश्रेष्ठ कार्यक्रमों की प्रस्तुति।.

programme.title: जंगल बुक
programme.sub-title: Mowgli, a young boy, is raised in the jungle by wolves. He has two loyal friends, Bagheera, a panther, and Baloo, a bear, who safeguard him from Shere Khan, a Bengal tiger, who wants to devour Mowgli
programme.desc: एक छोटा लड़का मोगली, जंगल में भेड़ियों के बीच पला-बढ़ा है। उसके दो वफादार दोस्त हैं, बघीरा (एक तेंदुआ), और बल्लू (एक भालू), जो उसे शेर खान (एक बंगाल टाइगर) से बचाते हैं, जो मोगली को खाना चाहता है।.

programme.title: बब्लू डबलू
programme.sub-title: An evil logger decides to turn the forest into his personal lumberyard. However, things change after Bablu and Dablu, two bear brothers, decide to stop him
programme.desc: एक दुष्ट लकड़हारा जंगल को अपना निजी लकड़हारा बनाने का फ़ैसला करता है। लेकिन, दो भालू भाइयों, बबलू और डबलू, द्वारा उसे रोकने के फ़ैसले के बाद चीज़ें बदल जाती हैं।.

programme.title: भूत बॉस (पाप-ओ-मीटर)
programme.sub-title: Bhoot Boss, Thakela and Pakela are ghosts who seek out people that have sinned and teach them a lesson to reduce wrongdoings in the world. However, their mission lands them in precarious situations
programme.desc: भूत बॉस, थकेला और पकेला भूत हैं जो पाप करने वाले लोगों को ढूंढ उन्हें सबक सिखाते हैं। हालांकि, उनका मिशन उन्हें अनिश्चित परिस्थितियों में डाल देता है।.

programme.title: जीजा जी छत पर है
programme.sub-title: Elaichi's mischievous antics keep her father Murari on edge, while Pancham, secretly in love with her, navigates hilarious mishaps due to his hidden marital status
programme.desc: इलायची की शरारतें उसके पिता मुरारी को परेशान रखती हैं, जबकि पंचम, जो मन ही मन इलायची से प्यार करता है, अपनी छुपी हुई वैवाहिक स्थिति के कारण हास्यास्पद घटनाओं से गुजरता है।.

credits.actor: Hiba Nawab,Nikhil Khurana,Anup Upadhyay,Soma Rathod,Harveer Singh,Raashi Bawa,Firoz Khan,Naveen Bawa,Saheb Das Manikpuri

programme.desc: வருடத்தில் மிகவும் பிரபலமான மற்றும் பிரியமான சில இசை எண்களின் விரிவான தொகுப்பு, தொடர்ச்சியாக இசைக்கப்பட்டது.

programme.title: Baal Krishna
programme.desc: Krishna, the young son of Devaki and Vasudeva, embarks on a series of adventures where he befriends the people of Vrindavan, his hometown, and saves them from difficulties.

credits.actor: Nimai Bali,Meet Mukhi,Sachin Shroff,Deshna Dugad,Ram Awana

programme.title: கணபதியே வருவாய்
programme.sub-title: After Lord Shiva beheads Ganesha, Goddess Parvati asks for his resurrection with an elephant's head. Despite facing many challenges after this, Ganesha transforms from an ostracized child into the most beloved deity
programme.desc: சிவன் கணேசனின் தலையை துண்டித்த பிறகு, பார்வதி தேவி யானை தலையுடன் மீண்டும் உயிர்ப்பிக்குமாறு கோரியபின், சவால்களை எதிர்கொண்டு, கணேசன் ஒதுக்கப்பட்ட குழந்தையிலிருந்து மிகவும் விரும்பப்படும் தெய்வமாகிறார்.

programme.title: கால பைரவன்
programme.sub-title: Jogeshwari is the daughter of Dakshan who hates Shiva and worships Vishnu. When Dakshan forces Jogeshwari to marry, she rebels because of her dedication towards Bhairavan, a devout devotee of Shiva
programme.desc: சிவனை வெறுத்து விஷ்ணுவை வழிபடும் தட்சன், அவரது மகள் ஜோகேஸ்வரியை திருமணம் செய்ய வற்புறுத்தும்போது, அவளோ சிவனின் தீவிர பக்தரான பைரவன் மீதான தனது பக்தியின் காரணமாக எதிர்க்கிறாள்.

programme.title: மூவி
programme.sub-title: Bringing the best in television
programme.desc: திரைப்படங்களில் சிறந்தவை.

programme.title: அண்ணாமலை
programme.sub-title: Generations of rivalry come to light as two families fight for control of a revered temple while personal emotions complicate the path to peace
programme.desc: தனிப்பட்ட உணர்வுகள் அமைதிக்கான பாதையை சிக்கலாக்கும் அதே வேளையில், ஒரு புனிதமான கோவிலின் கட்டுப்பாட்டிற்காக இரண்டு குடும்பங்கள் சண்டையிடுவதால், தலைமுறையாக இருந்துவரும் அவர்களின் பகைமை வெளிச்சத்திற்கு வருகிறது.

credits.actor: Sivakumar,Radikaa Sarathkumar,Shyam Ganesh,Kuyili,Ponvannan,Viji Chandrasekhar,Shanmuga Sundaram,Jyothi Lakshmi

programme.title: தாமரை
programme.sub-title: Sneha and Dwarkesh fall in love, and they secretly register their marriage. However, their relationship is tested as they face various obstacles
programme.desc: காதலர்களான சினேகாவும் துவாரகேஷும் ரகசியமாக பதிவு திருமணம் செய்து கொள்கிறார்கள். ஆனால், அவர்கள் பல்வேறு தடைகளைச் சந்திக்கும் பொழுது அவர்களின் உறவு சோதிக்கப்படுகிறது.

credits.director: K.J Thangapandiyan,Hafees,A. Ramachandran,M.K. Arunthavaraja,S. Anand Babu

programme.title: Selvi
programme.desc: Selvi, a young girl, has academic ambition that she wants to pursue by moving to the city from her village. However, her family wants her to get married.

programme.title: அம்மன்
programme.sub-title: Sakthi is blessed by the Goddess Amman with the power to foresee the future. Her life takes an unexpected turn when she meets an atheist doctor
programme.desc: அம்மன் தேவியால் சக்தி எதிர்காலத்தை கணிக்கும் அருளை பெறுகிறாள். அவள் ஒரு நாத்திக மருத்துவரை சந்திக்கும்போது, அவளது வாழ்க்கை எதிர்பாராத திருப்பத்தை அடைகிறது.

credits.actor: Pavithra Gowda (Sakthi),Amaljith (Eshwar),Nivisha (Durga),Surjith Ansary (Kishore),Nanditha Jennifer (Saradha),Nisha Jagadeeswaran (Logambal),Shaliy Avinesh (Logambal),Shobana (Naga),Anita Nair (Lakshmi),Rathan Ganapathy (Mahendran),Avinash Ashok (Aravindh),Anu Sulash (Neha),Shubha Raksha (Inba)

programme.title: கணபதியே வருவாய்
programme.sub-title: After Lord Shiva beheads Ganesha, Goddess Parvati asks for his resurrection with an elephant's head. Despite facing many challenges after this, Ganesha transforms from an ostracized child into the most beloved deity
programme.desc: சிவன் கணேசனின் தலையை துண்டித்த பிறகு, பார்வதி தேவி யானை தலையுடன் மீண்டும் உயிர்ப்பிக்குமாறு கோரியபின், சவால்களை எதிர்கொண்டு, கணேசன் ஒதுக்கப்பட்ட குழந்தையிலிருந்து மிகவும் விரும்பப்படும் தெய்வமாகிறார்.

programme.title: கர்ணா
programme.sub-title: Karna, the son of the Sun God and Kunti, faces hardships from birth but strives to prove his worth. Overcoming challenges, he rises to become one of the most formidable archers and warriors in the Mahabharata
programme.desc: பிறப்பிலிருந்தே பல சவால்களை தாண்டி மகாபாரதத்தில் சிறந்த வில்லாளி மற்றும் போர்வீரராகும் சூரியன், குந்தியின் மகன் கர்ணன்.

programme.title: தெனாலி ராமன்
programme.sub-title: Tenali Raman, an advisor at the court of King Krishnadevaraya, uses his sharp presence of mind and wisdom to solve the difficult matters of the kingdom and its people daily
programme.desc: தனது கூர்மையான மனதையும் ஞானத்தையும் பயன்படுத்தி, ராஜ்ஜியம் மற்றும் மக்களின் கடினமான விஷயங்களை தீர்க்கும் தெனாலி ராமன்.

credits.actor: Krishna Bharadwaj,Pankaj Berry,Manav Gohil,Jitendra Pathak,Sohit Soni,Sanjay Mangnani,Priyamvada Kant,Nimisha Vakharia

programme.title: வாடி ராசாத்தி
programme.sub-title: Anjana Shankaran, an ordinary girl with extraordinary dreams, aspires to become a District Collector and moreover, has the courage to claim the role of Chief Minister of Kerala one day
programme.desc: பெரிய கனவுகளையுடைய சாதாரண பெண் அஞ்சனா சங்கரன், மாவட்ட ஆட்சியர் ஆக விரும்புகிறாள். மேலும், அவளுக்கு ஒரு நாள் கேரளா முதல்வராகவும் உரிமை கோரும் தைரையமும் கொண்டவள் ஆவாள்.

programme.title: அலாதின்
programme.desc: Aladdin, a poor thief, discovers a magical lamp containing a Genie. However, soon he realizes that Zafar, an evil sorcerer, also desires the lamp to rule over Baghdad.

programme.desc: வருடத்தில் மிகவும் பிரபலமான மற்றும் பிரியமான சில இசை எண்களின் விரிவான தொகுப்பு, தொடர்ச்சியாக இசைக்கப்பட்டது.

programme.title: Baal Krishna
programme.desc: Krishna, the young son of Devaki and Vasudeva, embarks on a series of adventures where he befriends the people of Vrindavan, his hometown, and saves them from difficulties.

credits.actor: Nimai Bali,Meet Mukhi,Sachin Shroff,Deshna Dugad,Ram Awana

programme.title: கணபதியே வருவாய்
programme.sub-title: After Lord Shiva beheads Ganesha, Goddess Parvati asks for his resurrection with an elephant's head. Despite facing many challenges after this, Ganesha transforms from an ostracized child into the most beloved deity
programme.desc: சிவன் கணேசனின் தலையை துண்டித்த பிறகு, பார்வதி தேவி யானை தலையுடன் மீண்டும் உயிர்ப்பிக்குமாறு கோரியபின், சவால்களை எதிர்கொண்டு, கணேசன் ஒதுக்கப்பட்ட குழந்தையிலிருந்து மிகவும் விரும்பப்படும் தெய்வமாகிறார்.

programme.title: கால பைரவன்
programme.sub-title: Jogeshwari is the daughter of Dakshan who hates Shiva and worships Vishnu. When Dakshan forces Jogeshwari to marry, she rebels because of her dedication towards Bhairavan, a devout devotee of Shiva
programme.desc: சிவனை வெறுத்து விஷ்ணுவை வழிபடும் தட்சன், அவரது மகள் ஜோகேஸ்வரியை திருமணம் செய்ய வற்புறுத்தும்போது, அவளோ சிவனின் தீவிர பக்தரான பைரவன் மீதான தனது பக்தியின் காரணமாக எதிர்க்கிறாள்.

programme.title: மூவி
programme.sub-title: Bringing the best in television
programme.desc: திரைப்படங்களில் சிறந்தவை.

programme.title: அண்ணாமலை
programme.sub-title: Generations of rivalry come to light as two families fight for control of a revered temple while personal emotions complicate the path to peace
programme.desc: தனிப்பட்ட உணர்வுகள் அமைதிக்கான பாதையை சிக்கலாக்கும் அதே வேளையில், ஒரு புனிதமான கோவிலின் கட்டுப்பாட்டிற்காக இரண்டு குடும்பங்கள் சண்டையிடுவதால், தலைமுறையாக இருந்துவரும் அவர்களின் பகைமை வெளிச்சத்திற்கு வருகிறது.

credits.actor: Sivakumar,Radikaa Sarathkumar,Shyam Ganesh,Kuyili,Ponvannan,Viji Chandrasekhar,Shanmuga Sundaram,Jyothi Lakshmi

programme.title: தாமரை
programme.sub-title: Sneha and Dwarkesh fall in love, and they secretly register their marriage. However, their relationship is tested as they face various obstacles
programme.desc: காதலர்களான சினேகாவும் துவாரகேஷும் ரகசியமாக பதிவு திருமணம் செய்து கொள்கிறார்கள். ஆனால், அவர்கள் பல்வேறு தடைகளைச் சந்திக்கும் பொழுது அவர்களின் உறவு சோதிக்கப்படுகிறது.

credits.director: K.J Thangapandiyan,Hafees,A. Ramachandran,M.K. Arunthavaraja,S. Anand Babu

programme.title: அம்மன்
programme.sub-title: Sakthi is blessed by the Goddess Amman with the power to foresee the future. Her life takes an unexpected turn when she meets an atheist doctor

programme.desc: சகோதரிகளான துளசி மற்றும் மானசியில் ஒருத்தி தங்கள் தந்தையினுடைய எதிரி மகனை மணக்கத் தீர்மானிக்கும்போது, வரவிருக்கும் சிக்கல்களுடன் கூடிய ஒரு திருப்புமுனையை அவர்கள் எதிர்கொள்கிறார்கள்.

programme.title: चैंपियन
programme.sub-title: Rajveer, a police officer, is tasked with protecting a nine-year-old heir, Abbas. However, the job gets complicated when Nazir, a dangerous criminal, seeks to harm the child
programme.desc: पुलिस अधिकारी राजवीर को नौ वर्षीय वारिस अब्बास की सुरक्षा का काम सौंपा गया है। हालाँकि, यह काम जटिल हो जाता है, जब खतरनाक अपराधी नजीर उस बच्चे को नुकसान पहुंचाने की कोशिश करता है।.

credits.actor: Sunny Deol (Inspector Rajveer Singh),Manisha Koirala (Sapna Khanna),Rahul Dev (Nazeer Ahmed),Abhishek Sharma (Abbas Ali Khan),Kaivalya Chheda (Abbas's Friend),Jasmeet Jaggi (Abbas's Friend),Deepak Parashar (Nawab Mansoor Ali Khan),Padmini Kapila (Mrs. Mansoor Ali Khan),Kashmira Shah

programme.title: गैर कानूनी
programme.sub-title: Police Inspector Kapil Khanna realises that his baby boy has been switched with a girl child by the hospital and files a lawsuit against the owner, Robert Decosta, while trying to find his missing son
programme.desc: अधिकारी कपिल, बदमाश, डी'कोस्टा के खिलाफ सबूत हासिल करने के लिए अंडरवर्ल्ड, आज़म की मदद लेता है। जब आज़म को मार डाला जाता है,उसका बेटा,अकबर, कपिल को जिम्मेदार ठहराता है और प्रतिशोध लेता है।.

programme.title: कौन सच्चा कौन झूठा
programme.sub-title: Karan Saxena, a police officer, arrests Sapna Mathur, a woman accused of killing his fellow constable. Things take a turn when Karan falls in love with her and helps her escape her death sentence
programme.desc: एक पुलिसकर्मी करण, एक मनोचिकित्सक डॉ सपना से इलाज कराने और उस हत्या की जांच करने के लिए गुप्त रूप से जाता है जिसके लिए डॉ पर आरोप लगाया गया है।.

credits.actor: Rishi Kapoor (CBI Officer Karan Saxena),Sridevi (Sapna Mathur),Suresh Oberoi (IG Suryakant Verma),Gulshan Grover (K Kaushal),Mohnish Bahl (Mohnish),Tinnu Anand (Ramu Kaka),Vikas Anand (CBI officer Mukesh Agarwal),Avtar Gill (Doctor)

programme.title: मेरा करम मेरा धरम
programme.sub-title: Ajay, a businessman, provides funds to Sarjuprasad to develop his hometown. When he learns that the money has been misappropriated by Sarjuprasad, he resolves to set things right
programme.desc: एक व्यापारी अजय, सरजूप्रसाद को अपना घर बनवाने के लिए पैसे देता है। जब उसे पता चलता है कि सरजूप्रसाद द्वारा उसके पैसे का दुरुपयोग किया गया है, तब वह हालात ठीक करने का फैसला करता है।.

credits.actor: Dharmendra,Moushumi Chatterjee,Johnny Walker,Abhi Bhattacharya,Yogeeta Bali,Urmila Bhatt,Raj Mehra

programme.title: घर संसार
programme.sub-title: When Prakash's father dies, he is forced to shoulder the financial responsibilities of his large family. However, his troubles increase when his younger brother leaves him home to join a gang
programme.desc: प्रकाश को अपने पिता के आकस्मिक मृत्यु के बाद पूरे परिवार की ज़िम्मेदारी का ख्याल रखना होगा। उसका छोटा भाई चंदन लगातार उसके विवाहित जीवन को बर्बाद करने की कोशिश करता है।.

programme.title: त्रिदेव
programme.sub-title: When an expelled police inspector, an outlaw and a commissioner's son are implicated by a dealer, they unite to seek revenge and prove they are not culprits
programme.desc: एक निष्कासित पुलिस अधिकारी, एक डाकू और एक पुलिस आयुक्त के बेटे को एक तस्कर झूठे मामले में फँसा देता है। इसके बाद तीनों मिलकर, उसे सजा दिलाने की योजना बनाते हैं और खुद को निर्दोष साबित करते हैं।.

credits.actor: Jackie Shroff (Ravi Mathur),Madhuri Dixit (Divya Mathur),Sunny Deol (Inspector Karan Saxena),Amrish Puri (Bhujang/Bhairav Singh),Naseeruddin Shah (Jay Singh),Sangeeta Bijlani (Natasha Tejani),Anupam Kher (Commissioner Mathur),Sonam (Renu)

programme.title: सत्ता - द गेम ऑफ पावर
programme.sub-title: Anuradha relocates to Mumbai where she meets Vivek, an aspiring politician, and marries him. Things take a turn when he is arrested for murder, and she has to take his place in the upcoming elections
programme.desc: अनुराधा सहगल राजनीति के लिए मजबूर होती है, जब उसका पति, विवेक जेल जाता है। नतीजतन, उसका सरल जीवन अब संघर्षी हो जाता है।.

credits.actor: Raveena Tandon,Atul Kulkarni,Shri Vallabh Vyas,Govind Namdeo,Manoj Joshi,Latesh Shah,Hemendra Bhatia,Sameer Dharmadhikari

programme.title: Surkhaab
programme.sub-title: Jeet, a former judo champion, decides to travel to Canada in search of employment. However, since she has no money, she seeks the help of a local man who ends up cheating her
programme.desc: Si Jeet, isang dating kampeon ng judo, ay naglalakbay sa Canada upang maghanap ng trabaho. Dahil wala siyang pera, humihingi siya ng tulong sa isang trafficker na lolokohin siya.

credits.actor: Barkha Madan,Sumit Suri,Nishant Bahl,Kanza Feris,Naresh Gosain,Vineeta Malik,Reza Sholeh,Ashu Sharma

programme.title: चोट- आज इसको, कल तेरेको
programme.sub-title: Kishan, a dairy farmer, and Kabir, his brother, run into trouble when a local promoter decides to take over their land. When a corrupt inspector plays his part and kills Kabir, Kishan vows vengeance
programme.desc: एक डेयरी किसान, किशन और उसका भाई, कबीर मुसीबत में पड़ता हैं जब एक स्थानीय प्रमोटर उनकी ज़मीन पर कब्ज़ा करता है। एक भ्रष्ट इंस्पेक्टर अपनी भूमिका निभाता है और कबीर को मार देता है, तब किशन बदला लेता है।.

credits.actor: Ashutosh Rana,Sharad Kapoor,Rohit Nayyar,Jesse Randhawa,Nethra Raghuraman,Vineet Kumar,Hemant Mahaur,Ashok Banthia,Ganesh Yadav

programme.title: विश्वात्मा
programme.sub-title: A policeman and a reformed criminal go to Kenya to comprehend a syndicate leader. However, they must break the rules of the land defended by Surya Pratap, a Kenyan police inspector
programme.desc: प्रभात, एक पुलिसकर्मी और एक सुधरा हुए अपराधी, आकाश, एक अंडरवर्ल्ड डॉन को पकड़ने के लिए केन्या जाते हैं। हालांकि, इसके लिए उन्हें केन्याई पुलिसकर्मी सूर्य प्रताप द्वारा के नियमों को तोड़ना होगा।.

credits.actor: Naseeruddin Shah,Sunny Deol,Chunky Pandey,Divya Bharti,Sonam,Jyotsna Singh,Amrish Puri,Mahesh Anand,Kiran Kumar

programme.title: उधार की ज़िंदगी
programme.sub-title: Sitaram refuses to accept his son Vasudev's marriage to Suman. Years later, he eagerly awaits their return from the USA but is left disheartened when his granddaughter Sita turns up alone
programme.desc: सीताराम, अपने बेटे वासुदेव की सुमन के साथ हुई शादी को अस्वीकारता है। वर्षों बाद, वह अमरीका से उनकी वापसी का बेसब्री से इंतजार कर रहा है। वह फिर से दुखी होता है जब उसकी पोती, सीता अकेली ही आती है।.

credits.actor: Jeetendra,Moushumi Chatterjee,Kajol,Rohit Bhatia,Sujata Mehta,Tinnu Anand (Arjun's father),Ravi Kishan (Vasu),Shiva Rindani (Arjun),Mehmood (Radhe),Raghuveer Yadav (Suraj)

programme.title: अफ़लातून
programme.sub-title: Raja, a good-for-nothing fortune hunter, sets his sights on the daughter of a wealthy businessman. Before long, love takes over and brings about a twist in the tale
programme.desc: राजा को प्यार हो जाता है पर उसे अपने हमशक्ल, रॉकी का सामना करना पड़ेगा, ताकि वह अपनी प्रेमिका के पिता का दिल जीत सके। मुश्किलें आती हैं जब राजा, रॉकी बनता है और रॉकी, राजा बनता है।.

credits.actor: Akshay Kumar,Urmila Matondkar,Shazia Malik,Farida Jalal,Harish Patel,Anupam Kher,Tiku Talsania,Subbiraj,Sonia Sahni

programme.title: अवतार
programme.sub-title: Avatar leads a happy life with his wife, Radha, and his sons, Chander and Ramesh. However, consumed by their greed and ambitions, Avatar's sons betray him, but he soon reaches new heights of success
programme.desc: अवतार के बेटे उसे और उसकी पत्नी को उनके हाल पर छोड़ देते हैं। हालाँकि, अपने बेटों द्वारा बेदखल किए जाने पर अवतार सफलता की नई ऊँचाईयों पर पहुँचता है।.

credits.actor: Rajesh Khanna,Shabana Azmi,Madan Puri,Sujit Kumar,A. K. Hangal,Sachin,Gulshan Grover

programme.title: अमृत
programme.sub-title: A widowed man and woman face abuse from their respective children and seek comfort from each other instead
programme.desc: अपने बच्चों द्वारा प्रताड़ित एक बुज़ुर्ग विधवा, कमला, अमृत नाम के एक विधुर से मिलती है, जो खुद भी बच्चों द्वारा प्रताड़ित है।उनमें एक बंधन जुड़ने के बाद दोनों एक-दूसरे के दर्द को बाँटते हैं।.

credits.actor: Rajesh Khanna,Smita Patil,Aruna Irani,Anita Kanwar,Shafi Inamdar,Satish Shah,Rajesh Puri,Baby Guddu,Pradeep Saxena,Rishabh Shukla,Daljit Kaur,Master Ashutosh

programme.title: निशांत - द नाइट्स एण्ड
programme.sub-title: After his wife Rukmini is abducted by his cruel brother, Vishwam is forced to confront the deep-rooted issues of power and control that plague their village, leading to tragic consequences
programme.desc: अपनी पत्नी रुक्मिणी का क्रूर भाई द्वारा अपहरण कर लिए जाने के बाद, विश्वम को सत्ता और नियंत्रण के गहरे मुद्दों का सामना करना पड़ता है जो उनके गाँव को त्रस्त करते हैं और जिसके दुखद परिणाम सामने आते हैं।.

programme.title: तथास्तु
programme.sub-title: A factory worker's son needs a heart transplant, but the hospital will not go ahead with it without paying upfront. So, he is forced to take the law into his own hands to save his sick child
programme.desc: हालात से विवश एक मजदूर, अपने बीमार बच्चे के खातिर कानून को हाथ में लेने के लिए मजबूर होता है। जब वह हाथ में बंदूक उठाता है और अस्पताल में हंगामा मचाता है, तब लोगों को उसकी दुर्दशा का एहसास होता है।.

credits.actor: Sanjay Dutt (Ravi Rajput),Ameesha Patel (Sarita R. Rajput),Jayapradha (Dr. Nita),Gulshan Grover (DCP Rane),Darshan Jariwala (Surgeon),Ramakant Dayma (Insurance Co. Manager),Ravi Jhankal (Mangesh (Union Leader)),Anup Soni (Cop)

programme.title: बटालियन 609
programme.sub-title: Indian and Pakistani armies clash verbally, leading to a cricket match challenge where territorial pride hangs in the balance
programme.desc: भारतीय और पाकिस्तानी सेनाएँ मौखिक रूप से भिड़ जाती हैं, जिसके परिणामस्वरूप एक क्रिकेट मैच की चुनौती होती है, जहाँ क्षेत्रीय गौरव दाव पर लग जाता है।.

credits.actor: Shoaib Ibrahim,Elena Kazan,Farnaz Shetty,Sunil Gupta,Ram Awana,Vishwas Kini,Jashan Singh Kohli,Vikas Srivastav

programme.title: कथा
programme.sub-title: India 1982; Romance; Dir. Sai Paranjpye; Cast: Farooq Shaikh, Naseeruddin Shah, Deepti Naval. Rajaram, a middle-class clerk, is secretly in love with his neighbour, Sandhya, but is too shy to disclose his love. He is shocked when his smooth-talking friend comes visiting and soon woos Sandhya
programme.desc: राजाराम संध्या से प्यार करता है पर कभी अपनी चाहत का इजहार नहीं कर पाता। इस बीच उसका बातूनी दोस्त संध्या को आकर्षित करने लगता है।.

credits.actor: Naseeruddin Shah,Farooq Shaikh,Deepti Naval,Hemu Adhikari,Sudha Chopra (Club Singer),Suhasini Deshpande (Mrs. Sabnis)

programme.title: चलता है यार
programme.sub-title: Frustrated with his wife, Namdev, a businessman, decides to end his life. However, things take a turn when he envisions his dead father who encourages him to rethink his decision
programme.desc: पत्नी से परेशान होकर, नामदेव नामक एक व्यवसायी अपनी जीवन लीला समाप्त करने का फैसला करता है। हालांकि, चीजें बदल जाती हैं जब वह अपने दिवंगत पिता की कल्पना करता है जो उसे अपने फैसले पर पुनर्विचार करता है।.

programme.title: ఆసీ స్నేక్ రాంగ్లర్స్
programme.sub-title: An aggravated eastern brown snake drive Mick and Adele nuts before the team are called to the biggest tree snake they've ever seen. For Stuart and Olivia, it's demolition time
programme.desc: ఆస్ట్రేలియన్ ఇళ్లలో చొరబడిన ప్రాణాంతకమైన పాములను పట్టుకునే క్రమంలో నిపుణులు ప్రమాదకర పరిస్థితులు ఎదుర్కొంటారు.

programme.title: లైఫ్ ఆఫ్ ఎ ప్రిడేటర్
programme.desc: Track three apex predators, a golden eagle, an Iberian lynx and a red fox, as they navigate changing seasons and deploy unique hunting strategies to survive within their shared Mediterranean forest territory.

programme.title: సర్వైవింగ్ ఆస్ట్రేలియా
programme.sub-title: Survivors recount incidents of being lost in the Australian wilderness, getting stuck underground, being caught in landslides, and having close encounters with some of the country's deadliest inhabitants
programme.desc: ప్రాణాలతో బయటపడినవారు ఆస్ట్రేలియన్ అవుట్‌బ్యాక్ నుండి తాము ఎదుర్కొన్న భయంకరమైన తప్పించుకునే అనుభవాలను వివరిస్తారు.

programme.title: డెడ్లీయెస్ట్ సౌతాఫ్రికా
programme.sub-title: Kurt Greenwood is on a quest to seek out South Africa's 12 most deadly snakes and to educate and inspire people to see the value of these often misunderstood creatures
programme.desc: కుర్డ్ గ్రీన్‌వుడ్, దక్షిణాఫ్రికాలోని ప్రాణాంతకమైన పన్నెండు రకాల పాములను అన్వేషిస్తూ, వాటి గురించి అవగాహన కలిగిస్తారు.

programme.title: సీక్రెట్స్ ఆఫ్ ది ఫ్లడెడ్ ఫారెస్ట్
programme.sub-title: Mediterranean beech woods are considered among the most beautiful and important on the continent
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు డానుబే నదీతీర అడవుల పర్యావరణ వ్యవస్థలో అభివృద్ధి చెందుతున్న ప్రత్యేకమైన వన్యప్రాణుల రూపాన్ని అందించారు.

programme.title: బ్రదర్‌హుడ్ ఆఫ్ లయన్స్
programme.sub-title: The young males of the lion pride must form a coalition to work together against their rivals, but they first need to leave their mothers at two years old and fend for themselves
programme.desc: కెన్యాలోని మసాయి మారా రిజర్వ్‌లో నివసిస్తున్న ఐదు యువ సింహాల జీవితం, వేట, నివాస విషయంలో ఎదుర్కొంటున్న సమస్యలను చూపుతారు.

programme.title: ఆసీ స్నేక్ రాంగ్లర్స్
programme.sub-title: Chris and Stu come face-to-face with a giant red-bellied black snake that's taking shelter in a car's engine. In South Australia, Mick and Adele are helping local snake catcher, Dan, with one of his busiest snake catching seasons on record
programme.desc: ఆస్ట్రేలియన్ ఇళ్లలో చొరబడిన ప్రాణాంతకమైన పాములను పట్టుకునే క్రమంలో నిపుణులు ప్రమాదకర పరిస్థితులు ఎదుర్కొంటారు.

programme.title: ఆసీ స్నేక్ రాంగ్లర్స్
programme.sub-title: An aggravated eastern brown snake drive Mick and Adele nuts before the team are called to the biggest tree snake they've ever seen. For Stuart and Olivia, it's demolition time
programme.desc: ఆస్ట్రేలియన్ ఇళ్లలో చొరబడిన ప్రాణాంతకమైన పాములను పట్టుకునే క్రమంలో నిపుణులు ప్రమాదకర పరిస్థితులు ఎదుర్కొంటారు.

programme.title: ది హిప్పో కింగ్
programme.sub-title: The life story of a charismatic hippo in Zambia's Luangwa Valley. Over 35 years, he grows from a small calf to a full-fledged leader. His experiences make him stronger and stronger, until he is ready for kingship
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు ఒక పెద్ద హిప్పో బుల్ నిజమైన స్వభావం,అంతగా తెలియని జీవితంపై వివరిస్తారు.

programme.title: టెక్సాస్ గేటర్ సేవర్స్
programme.sub-title: Gary searches for a gator in a disgusting drainage ditch while Arlie finds one hanging out in a crystal clear pool. Then, the Gator Country team hits the road for a show in Fort Worth
programme.desc: గ్యారీ సౌరేజ్, అతని బృందం వివిధ అసాధారణ ప్రదేశాలలోని మొసళ్ళను రక్షించి, కొత్త వాతావరణంలో వాటి సంక్షేమానికి తోడ్పడతారు.

programme.title: ది సావన్నా: వైల్డ్ హ్యాపీనెస్
programme.desc: The Savannah: Wild Happiness.

programme.title: రివర్ మాన్స్టర్స్
programme.sub-title: Jeremy Wade investigates a case in Nepal that sounds strangely familiar - a lone fisherman dragged off his feet and into a mountain river by the original river monster, the goonch catfish
programme.desc: జీవశాస్త్రవేత్త జెరెమీ వేడ్ పురాణాలు, స్వచ్ఛమైననీటి రహస్యాలు, జానపద కథలను అన్వేషించడానికి బయలుదేరాడు.

credits.actor: Jeremy Wade,Vic Hislop,David Buckmeier,Mark Spitzer,Tim Mousseau,Daniel Göz

programme.title: నేచర్స్ ఫాస్ట్ ఎటాక్స్
programme.sub-title: Showcasing how the world's fastest predators can strike and kill in the blink of an eye, using modern high-speed cameras to capture these lightning-fast attacks in deadly detail
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు తమవేగాన్ని, చురుకుదనాన్ని ఉపయోగించి తమ ఎరను పట్టుకునే వేటాడే జంతువులను చూపడానికి ప్రపంచవ్యాప్తంగా పర్యటిస్తారు.

programme.title: బాస్టన్స్ ఆఫ్ ద జెయింట్స్
programme.sub-title: An engrossing journey into the lives of Asian Elephants, and the stunning bio-diverse North Eastern jungles of India around the river Brahmaputra
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు, ఈశాన్య భారతదేశంలోని అడవులలో నివసించే ఆసియా ఏనుగుల జీవితాలు, మానవులు, జంతు పరిరక్షణ ప్రయత్నాలను చూపుతారు.

programme.title: లోవెన్ గెగెన్ హైయనెన్
programme.sub-title: A year has passed since the lionesses of the Boulder Pride bore their cubs. The youngsters have got much bigger and, amazingly, all nine have survived. But the lions in the northern savannah on the border of Kenya and Tanzania have a problem

programme.title: స్నో లెపర్డ్స్ విత్ డాన్ ఓనీల్‌
programme.sub-title: Navigating the harsh Mongolian wilderness with Dan O'Neill as he searches for 'The Dude', the largest snow leopard ever recorded
programme.desc: ప్రకృతి, జీవ శాస్త్రవేత్త అయిన డాన్ ఓనీల్, ఒక పరిశోధనా కేంద్రాన్ని నిర్మించి, మంచు చిరుతపులిపై అధ్యయనం చేస్తారు.

programme.title: వోల్వ్స్: పవర్ ఆఫ్ ది ప్యాక్
programme.sub-title: From the arctic tundra to the great plains, the kingdom of the wolf extends across the entire northern hemisphere. They are icons of the wilderness, spectacular creatures that live and die by the sword
programme.desc: ఆర్కిటిక్ టండ్రా నుండి విశాల మైదానాల వరకు, తోడేళ్ల సామ్రాజ్యం ఉత్తరార్ధగోళం అంతటా విస్తరించి ఉంది. ఇవి అరణ్యానికి ప్రతీకలు.

programme.title: Krugers Wild Kingdom
programme.desc: Krugers Wild Kingdom.

programme.sub-title: Kurt Greenwood is on a quest to seek out South Africa's 12 most deadly snakes and to educate and inspire people to see the value of these often misunderstood creatures

programme.sub-title: Tigers in general are believed to be solitary hunters. But in the forests of Central India, a gang of females learned to hunt co-operatively, taking down large, dangerous prey

programme.sub-title: Sean Duggan travels to Thailand to investigate the giant snakehead fish in its native habitat. Sean's expedition takes him from Thailand to snakehead-infested Arkansas to see if this killer fish can be stopped
programme.desc: Adventurer Sean Duggan heads to some of the most remote places on Earth in search of mysterious creatures - from land-prowling fish to giant predatory reptiles - in `Natural Born Monsters'. Duggan often enlists the help of local experts to locate and investigate the creatures and get the information he seeks.

programme.sub-title: From the arctic tundra to the great plains, the kingdom of the wolf extends across the entire northern hemisphere. They are icons of the wilderness, spectacular creatures that live and die by the sword
programme.desc: ఆర్కిటిక్ టండ్రా నుండి విశాల మైదానాల వరకు, తోడేళ్ల సామ్రాజ్యం ఉత్తరార్ధగోళం అంతటా విస్తరించి ఉంది. ఇవి అరణ్యానికి ప్రతీకలు.

programme.title: అటెన్‌బరోస్ లైఫ్ ఇన్ కలర్
programme.sub-title: In India, peacocks dazzle females with magnificent tail feathers; a tiny hummingbird in the deserts of North America unfurls his spectacular headdress as he dances for a mate; and in the darkness of a rainforest, powerful mandrill baboons signal their status with red and blue face masks, while tiny frogs warn of deadly poisons with brilliant colours
programme.desc: David Attenborough explores the vital role that colour plays in the daily life of various species. For us humans, it is a source of aesthetic beauty and expression, but for animals it is an essential tool used for survival and without it, there would be catastrophic consequences. Colours help animals to win a mate, to fight off rivals and to warn enemies. Attenborough explores nature's use of colour using technological advancements in camera equipment to reveal the world, as seen by animals.

programme.desc: దర్శకుడు తమవేగాన్ని, చురుకుదనాన్ని ఉపయోగించి తమ ఎరను పట్టుకునే వేటాడే జంతువులను చూపడానికి ప్రపంచవ్యాప్తంగా పర్యటిస్తారు.

programme.title: బాస్టన్స్ ఆఫ్ ద జెయింట్స్
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker explores the lives of Asian elephants in the jungles of Northeast India, highlighting conservation efforts to ensure a harmonious future for both humans and wildlife
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు, ఈశాన్య భారతదేశంలోని అడవులలో నివసించే ఆసియా ఏనుగుల జీవితాలు, మానవులు, జంతు పరిరక్షణ ప్రయత్నాలను చూపుతారు.

programme.title: లోవెన్ గెగెన్ హైయనెన్
programme.sub-title: It has been a year since the lionesses of the Boulder Pride gave birth to their cubs. Now, they must hunt without the support of the rest of the family, with hyenas hot on their heels
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు సింహాలు, హైనాల ప్రవర్తనను పరిశీలించి, వాటి శత్రుత్వానికి ప్రేరేపించిన ఆలోచనలను సవాలు చేస్తారు.

programme.title: స్నో లెపర్డ్స్ విత్ డాన్ ఓనీల్‌
programme.sub-title: Dan O'Neill, a biologist and naturalist, travels to Central Asia in an attempt to build a research centre and study the snow leopard
programme.desc: ప్రకృతి, జీవ శాస్త్రవేత్త అయిన డాన్ ఓనీల్, ఒక పరిశోధనా కేంద్రాన్ని నిర్మించి, మంచు చిరుతపులిపై అధ్యయనం చేస్తారు.

programme.title: వోల్వ్స్: పవర్ ఆఫ్ ది ప్యాక్
programme.sub-title: From the Arctic tundra to the Great Plains, the kingdom of the wolf extends across the entire Northern Hemisphere; wolves are icons of the wilderness and spectacular creatures that live and die by the sword
programme.desc: ఆర్కిటిక్ టండ్రా నుండి విశాల మైదానాల వరకు, తోడేళ్ల సామ్రాజ్యం ఉత్తరార్ధగోళం అంతటా విస్తరించి ఉంది. ఇవి అరణ్యానికి ప్రతీకలు.

programme.title: ఎ గేమ్ ఆఫ్ లెపర్డ్ థ్రోన్స్
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker captures the leopard who fiercely reigns as the queen of the territory, facing perils and also mother to eight cubs
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు దక్షిణాఫ్రికాలోని సాబి సాండ్స్‌లో ఉన్న చిరుతపులి రాజ కుటుంబ సభ్యుల మధ్య వివాదం గురించి చూపుతారు.

programme.title: Krugers Wild Kingdom
programme.desc: Krugers Wild Kingdom.

programme.title: డెడ్లీయెస్ట్ సౌతాఫ్రికా
programme.sub-title: Kurt Greenwood is on a quest to seek out South Africa's most deadly snakes in order to educate and inspire people to see the value of these misunderstood creatures
programme.desc: కుర్డ్ గ్రీన్‌వుడ్, దక్షిణాఫ్రికాలోని ప్రాణాంతకమైన పన్నెండు రకాల పాములను అన్వేషిస్తూ, వాటి గురించి అవగాహన కలిగిస్తారు.

programme.title: టైగ్రెస్ బ్లడ్
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker explores the lives of four tigresses in Central India who are rewriting the rules of how a tiger pack survives and hunts
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు మధ్య భారతదేశంలోని నాలుగు పులుల జీవితాలను అన్వేషించారు, అవి పులి ప్యాక్ ఎలా జీవించి వేటాడుతుంది.

programme.title: న్యాచురల్ బార్న్ మాన్‌స్టర్స్
programme.desc: Adventurer Sean Duggan heads to some of the most remote places on Earth in search of mysterious creatures -- from land-prowling fish to giant predatory reptiles -- in \"Natural Born Monsters.\" When he unearths the creatures, he investigates how they have adapted to extreme weather conditions to survive in their often-dangerous environments and how weather has shaped the animals themselves. Duggan often enlists the help of local experts to locate and investigate the creatures and get the information he seeks.

programme.sub-title: The host sheds light on the various aspects of animal relationships, from competitive mating and fierce battles for mates to cooperative friendships and familial bonds

programme.sub-title: In Djuma Private Game Reserve, peace is short-lived as Tingana falls mysteriously ill and the threat of Hukumuri taking over the leap of leopards looms ahead

programme.sub-title: While the winter floods tire Melelo's pride, elsewhere, Sephiri encounters something scary that puts her in a critical position
programme.desc: మూడు పెద్ద పిల్లి కుటుంబాలు ఉమ్మడి స్థలంలో సహజీవనం చేస్తూనే ప్రత్యర్థులను అధిగమించడానికి వారి నైపుణ్యాలను ఉపయోగిస్తాయి.

programme.title: లయన్స్ వర్సెస్ హైనాస్
programme.sub-title: Wildlife experts offer detailed insights into lionesses and hyenas nursing their young and teaching them how to adapt to the wild
programme.desc: చిత్రదర్శకుడు ఎన్నో ఏళ్లుగా ప్రజలు తప్పుగా అర్థం చేసుంటున్న సింహాలు, హైనాల మధ్య జరిగే సంఘర్షణ గురించి చూపుతారు.

programme.title: లైఫ్ ఆఫ్ ఎ ప్రిడేటర్
programme.desc: Track three apex predators, a golden eagle, an Iberian lynx and a red fox, as they navigate changing seasons and deploy unique hunting strategies to survive within their shared Mediterranean forest territory.

programme.title: బిగ్ క్యాట్ టేల్స్
programme.sub-title: Chongo is unwilling to share the buffalo with the rest of the pride while Fig continues to give lessons to the young cub
programme.desc: మనుగడ, సహవాసం, వేట, సంతానం కోసం పోరాడే పెద్ద పిల్లుల జాతి రోజువారీ జీవితం గురించి ఓ బృందం చిత్రీకరిస్తారు.

programme.title: గ్రేట్ పార్క్స్ ఆఫ్ ఆఫ్రికా
programme.sub-title: Home to a wide range of animals from mountain zebras to secretive caracals, Karoo National Park is known for its diverse inhabitants and unique landscape
programme.desc: ఆఫ్రికాలోని పచ్చని విభిన్న సహజ అభయారణ్యాలు అందమైన ప్రకృతికి, విభిన్న రకాల క్రూరమైన జంతువులకు ఆశ్రయాన్ని అందిస్తాయి.

programme.title: Wild Kashmir
programme.desc: Wild Kashmir.

programme.title: షేర్డ్ స్పేసెస్
programme.desc: Shared Spaces.

programme.title: న్యాచురల్ బార్న్ మాన్‌స్టర్స్
programme.desc: Adventurer Sean Duggan heads to some of the most remote places on Earth in search of mysterious creatures -- from land-prowling fish to giant predatory reptiles -- in \"Natural Born Monsters.\" When he unearths the creatures, he investigates how they have adapted to extreme weather conditions to survive in their often-dangerous environments and how weather has shaped the animals themselves. Duggan often enlists the help of local experts to locate and investigate the creatures and get the information he seeks.

programme.title: జురాసిక్ షార్క్స్
programme.sub-title: Prehistoric sharks rise from the dead as biologists investigate early predators that ruled the seas; global expeditions yield new evidence of sharks that once roamed the ocean, and CGI technology brings them back to life
programme.desc: సముద్రాలను ఏలిన తొలి వేటగాళ్లపై జీవశాస్త్రవేత్తలు పరిశోధనలు చేస్తుండగా, చరిత్రపూర్వపు సొరచేపలు మృత్యువు నుండి తిరిగి ప్రాణం పోసుకుంటాయి.

programme.title: డెడ్లీయెస్ట్ సౌతాఫ్రికా
programme.sub-title: Kurdt Greenwood is on a quest to seek out South Africa's 12 most deadly snakes and to educate people to see the value of these often-misunderstood creatures
programme.desc: కుర్డ్ గ్రీన్‌వుడ్, దక్షిణాఫ్రికాలోని ప్రాణాంతకమైన పన్నెండు రకాల పాములను అన్వేషిస్తూ, వాటి గురించి అవగాహన కలిగిస్తారు.

programme.title: బ్రదర్‌హుడ్ ఆఫ్ లయన్స్
programme.sub-title: Four lion cubs at the Masai Mara Reserve prey on the buffaloes and one of them emerges as a dominant leader to guide the pride in attacking their victim
programme.desc: కెన్యాలోని మసాయి మారా రిజర్వ్‌లో నివసిస్తున్న ఐదు యువ సింహాల జీవితం, వేట, నివాస విషయంలో ఎదుర్కొంటున్న సమస్యలను చూపుతారు.

programme.title: అటెన్‌బరోస్ లైఫ్ ఇన్ కలర్
programme.desc: Sir David Attenborough uses innovative technology to explore how color plays a vital role in animal interactions.

programme.title: టైగర్ ఫిష్: ఆఫ్రికా పిరాన్హా
programme.sub-title: A conservationist journeys through the rivers of Africa to study the behaviour of the Tigerfish, a ferocious fish species with an aggressive nature and sharp teeth
programme.desc: వ్యాఖ్యాత ఆఫ్రికా నదుల గుండా ప్రయాణిస్తూ, పదునైన దంతాలు కలిగిన చేప జాతి అయిన టైగర్ ఫిష్ ప్రవర్తనను అధ్యయనం చేస్తారు.

programme.title: ఆసీ స్నేక్ రాంగ్లర్స్
programme.sub-title: Experts encounter life-threatening situations as they try to catch some of the world's deadliest snakes hiding in Australian homes
programme.desc: ఆస్ట్రేలియన్ ఇళ్లలో చొరబడిన ప్రాణాంతకమైన పాములను పట్టుకునే క్రమంలో నిపుణులు ప్రమాదకర పరిస్థితులు ఎదుర్కొంటారు.

SpongeBob SquarePants: Culture Shock / F.U.N.
programme.sub-title: Kulturschock / F.U.N
programme.desc: SpongeBob Schwammkopf wohnt mit seiner Schnecke Gary in der Unterwasserstadt Bikini Bottom in einer Zwei-Zimmer-Ananas und arbeitet als Krabbenburgerbrater im Fastfood-Restaurant 'Krosse Krabbe', wo Mr. Krabs sein Chef ist. Neben dem Schwammkopf ist SpongeBobs Markenzeichen die eckige Quadrathose. Seine Freunde sind Tintenfisch Thaddäus, Eichhorn Sandy und Seestern Patrick. Sein Feind ist der fiese Plankton, der an das Geheimrezept der Krabbenburger und die Weltherrschaft gelangen will. Die Serie basiert auf wahren Begebenheiten. Nun, zumindest ist ihr Erfinder Stephen Hillenburg ausgebildeter Meeresbiologe, er müsste also wissen, wie es da unten zugeht.

SpongeBob SquarePants: A Friendly Game / Sentimental Sponge
programme.sub-title: Sportsfeinde / Andenken
programme.desc: Aufgrund schlechten Wetters verwandeln SpongeBob und Patrick das Schwammkopfsche Wohnzimmer in eine Minigolfanlage. Leider verlagert sich das Spielgeschehen irgendwann hinüber zu Nachbar Thaddäus, dessen Einrichtung unter wuchtigen Schlägen schwer zu leiden hat - und nicht nur die... // Patrick schimpft mit SpongeBob, weil der im Zuge des Frühjahrsputzes auch einige Andenken dem Müll überantwortet hat. Das nimmt sich unser Schwamm zu Herzen und hortet nun jede Kleinigkeit mit potentiellem Erinnerungswert - bis der Müll überhand nimmt und Thaddäus sich gezwungen sieht, die Gesundheitspolizei zu rufen..

programme.title: SpongeBob Schwammkopf 8
SpongeBob SquarePants: Frozen Face Off
programme.sub-title: Unter Null unter Wasser
programme.desc: Das große Schlittenrennen von Bikini Bottom ist in diesem Jahr durch einen anonymen Gönner mit einer Million Dollar dotiert! Natürlich ist die ganze Stadt am Start. Natürlich versuchen einige, sich durch unlautere Tricks Vorteile zu verschaffen. Natürlich landen alle Bruchpiloten irgendwann in SpongeBobs Schlitten, den der arme Gary zu ziehen hat, und müssen sich neben den Unbilden der Witterung auch mit einem veritablen Schneemonster zur auseinandersetzen - und natürlich ahnt keiner unserer Helden, dass das ganze Rennen nur ein Ablenkungsmanöver Planktons ist, der damit hofft, endlich an die Krabbenburger-Geheimformel zu gelangen..

programme.desc: Plankton sieht ein, dass er den Kampf gegen Mr. Krabs' erfolgreiches Fastfood-Restaurant nicht gewinnen kann. Er glaubt, dass alles zu Planktons neuestem Plan gehört, um an sein legendäres Krabbenburger-Rezept zu kommen... // SpongeBobs Hausschnecke Gary ist in letzter Zeit etwas zu beißfreudig - und als erster bekommt das Thaddäus zu spüren. Fortan ist der Tintenfisch davon überzeugt, dass Gary mit seinem Biss eine furchtbare Schneckenkrankheit überträgt und hetzt die anderen Meeresbewohner gegen ihn auf. Das gipfelt in einer furiosen Verfolgungsjagd..
